Omu Christian Scientist akozesa ekigambo "okutangirira," naye ategeeza kintu kirala ddala okusinga Bayibuli ky’eyigiriza ku kufa kwa Yesu Kristo okutangirira. N’ow’eddiini ya Unitarian bw’atyo. N’abaweereza bangi ab’amadiini agayitibwa ag’enzikiriza entuufu bwe batyo. Omusumba w’ekkanisa ya Congregational mu kibuga kino yagamba gye buvuddeko nti: "Nnina eddiini yange ey’engeri yange; enmala nze, naye nsuubira nti nnina amagezi agamala okulaba nti teyandimaze buli muntu. Nkuba ekifaananyi ky’omukulu wa Salvation Army ng’abuulira enjigiriza y’eddiini eringa eyange, awatali Setaani, awatali ggeyeena, awatali kutangirira kwa musaayi na kusasula, awatali Bayibuli etasobya—ne ndaba abamuwuliriza nga basaanuuka ng’omuzira mu nkuba. Enjigiriza ye esinga eyange obutuufu, oba eyange y’esinga eyiye? Nedda, si emu ku zo; eyiye ya mazima gy’ali, n’eyange gye ndi—ekyo kyokka—buli emu ng’engeri yaayo bw’eri." Kino kiyinza okuwulikika ng’obugumiikiriza era ekintu ekirungi, naye bwe busirusiru obw’enkukunala. Enjigiriza yonna etali ya mazima eri buli muntu si ya mazima eri muntu yenna, era enjigiriza yonna ey’amazima ya mazima eri buli muntu. Enjigiriza eggyamu "okutangirira kw’omusaayi" bw’eba nga si ya mazima eri Salvation Army—era ddala si ya mazima—si ya mazima eri muntu mulala yenna. Amazima tegakyuka okusinziira ku muntu; gali ga mazima ddala. Ekiri eky’amazima kiba kya mazima, n’ekiri eky’obulimba kiba kya bulimba. Bwe tutyo tutuuka maaso ku maaso n’ekibuuzo kino: Bayibuli eyigiriza ki ku njigiriza eno ennene ey’omusingi? I. OBWETAAVU N’OBUKULU BW’OKUFA KWE Ekintu ekisooka Bayibuli ky’eyigiriza lwatu ku kibuuzo kino kwe kwetaagisa ddala n’obukulu obw’omusingi obw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo, okwetaagisa ddala n’obukulu obw’omusingi obw’okuyiwa omusaayi gwe. Mu nnaku zaffe mu bibiina bya Unitarian, ne mu bibiina eby’enzikiriza entuufu ebizimbulukusiddwa ekizimbulukusa ekyonoona ekya Unitarian, waliwo omuze ogw’okukendeeza ku bukulu bw’okufa kwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Omuze kwe kufuula obulamu bwe n’empisa ze, okuyigiriza kwe n’obukulembeze bwe, ekintu ekikulu. Christian Science yo egenda n’okwegaana nti teyafa n’akatono. Gye bali okufa kwe kwe balowooza nti "kirooto," "ndowooza ya bantu bokka," naye Bayibuli essa essira ku kufa kwe okutangirira. 1. Okufa kwa Yesu Kristo kwogerwako butereevu emirundi egisukka mu 175 mu Ndagaano Empya. Ku ekyo kwossaako, mu Ndagaano Enkadde mulimu obunnabbi bungi n’ebifaananyi bingi ebyogera ku kufa kwa Yesu Kristo. Bwe twali tukuba enkuŋŋaana zaffe ne Omwami Alexander mu Royal Albert Hall e London, omuntu omu yatwala ekimu ku bitabo byaffe eby’ennyimba, n’akiyitamu, n’asalamu buli wantu we kyogera ku musaayi, n’akinzizaayo ng’akiyisa mu posita, ng’agamba nti, "Nkiyiseemu ekitabo kyo eky’ennyimba ne nsalamu buli wantu we kyogera ku musaayi. Ebigambo bino ebyogera ku musaayi bya busirusiru. Kaakano muyimbe ennyimba zammwe nga omusaayi muguggyeemu, mujja kubaamu amakulu." Singa omu ku mmwe yatwala Bayibuli ye n’agiyitamu mu ngeri eyo, n’asalamu mu Ndagaano Empya ne mu Ndagaano Enkadde buli kitundu ekyogera ku kufa kwa Kristo, oba ku musaayi gwe ogutangirira, wandisigazza Bayibuli eyayulikayulise ennyo, Bayibuli etalina mutima, n’Enjiri etalina maanyi ga kulokola. Singa nnali mmemba w’ekkanisa omusumba waayo mw’agambira nti abuulira enkola ya "njigiriza ya ddiini, awatali Setaani, awatali ggeyeena, awatali kutangirira kwa musaayi na kusasula, awatali Bayibuli etasobya," okukozesa ebigambo bye ye, yandirabye abamuwuliriza "nga basaanuuka ng’omuzira mu nkuba" ku lwange. Nnandikutte enkoofiira yange ne nva mu kkanisa eyo, oba omusumba ye yandikutte enkoofiira ye n’ava ku mumbiri; kubanga nnandimanyi nti tabuulira njiri ya Katonda ennongoofu erokola, wabula ekyo Setaani kye yazzaawo mu kifo ky’enjiri, eky’obutwa. 2. Si nti bya kwogera ku kufa kwa Kristo byokka bye bingi mu Ndagaano Enkadde ne mu Ndagaano Empya, wabula tuyigirizibwa lwatu mu Abaebbulaniya 2:14 nti Yesu Kristo yafuuka omuntu olw’ekigendererwa kino kyennyini eky’okufa, nti yafuna omubiri n’omusaayi alyoke afe. Mu kitundu kino tusoma nti, "Olw’okubanga abaana balina omubiri n’omusaayi, naye yalina omubiri n’omusaayi, alyoke azikirize oyo alina amaanyi ag’okufa, ye Setaani." (Abaebbulaniya 2:14). Amakulu g’ebigambo bino gatangaala ng’emisana. Gatubuulira nti okufuuka omuntu kwali kwa kigendererwa kya kufa. Gatubuulira nti okufa kwa Yesu Kristo tekwali kabenje bubenje oba kintu ekyagwawo obugwi mu bulamu bwe obw’obuntu (nga bangi bwe bandyagadde tukikkirize), wabula nti kwe kwali ekigendererwa kyabwo ekisinga obukulu. Yafuuka omuntu alyoke afe ng’omuntu era ku lw’omuntu. Eno ye njigiriza ya Bayibuli, era ya mazima eri buli muntu n’eri abantu bonna. 3. Ate era, yafa olw’ekigendererwa ekimu ekyategeerekeka, ng’omutango ku lwaffe. Ye kennyini bwe yagamba. Mu Matayo 20:28 agamba nti, "Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi." 4. Emu ku bintu ebisinga okwewuunyisa ebiwandiikibwa mu Ndagaano Empya ye y’okufuusibwa kwa Yesu, Musa ne Eriya bwe baakomawo okuva mu nsi endala okunyumya ne Yesu. Kale baali boogera ku ki mu kaseera ako akakulu mu byafaayo by’abantu? Lukka atubuulira mu ssuula ya 9 ey’Enjiri ye, ennyiriri 30 ne 31, "Awo, laba, ne banyumya naye (kwe kugamba, ne Yesu) abantu babiri, omu yali Musa n’omulala Eriya, abaali bamasamasa mu kitiibwa kyabwe nga boogera ku kufa kwa Yesu, kwe yali agenda okutuukiriza mu Yerusaalemi." Okufa kwe okutangirira kwe kwali ensonga yokka eyali eyeesedde ebirowoozo by’abantu bano ababiri abaakomawo okuva mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa. Era tubuulirwa mu 1 Peetero 1:10-12 nti okufa kwa Yesu Kristo nsonga bamalayika gye baagala okumanya ennyo era gye banoonyereza n’obunyiikivu. 5. Okufa kwa Kristo gwe mulamwa omukulu ogw’oluyimba lw’eggulu. Okubikkulirwa 5:8-12 kutuwa ekifaananyi ky’eggulu n’ekibiina kyalyo eky’abayimbi ekyewuunyisa eky’emitwalo n’emitwalo n’enkumi n’enkumi, era luno lwe lulimi olunnyonnyola oluyimba lwe bayimba: "Bwe yagukwata, ebiramu ebina n’abakadde amakumi abiri mu abana, ne bagwa mu maaso g’Omwana gw’Endiga ne bavuunama, buli omu ng’alina ennanga era ng’akutte ekibya ekya zaabu, ekyali kijjudde obubaane obwakaloosa nga butegeeza okusaba kw’abantu abatukuvu. Baali bamuyimbira oluyimba oluggya nti, Ggw’osaanidde okutoola omuzingo gw’ekitabo, n’okusumulula ebigusibye n’okuguzingulula, kubanga wattibwa, omusaayi gwo ne gununula abantu ba Katonda okubaggya mu buli kika, na buli lulimi, na buli ggwanga, na buli nsi. N’obafuula obwakabaka ne bakabona ba Katonda okumuweerezanga, era be balifuga ensi. Awo ne ndaba era ne mpulira eddoboozi lya bamalayika enkumi n’enkumi, n’enkuyanja nga beetoolodde entebe ey’obwakabaka awamu n’ebiramu biri n’abakadde bali. Ne boogera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, Omwana gw’Endiga eyattibwa, asaanidde okuweebwa obuyinza, n’obugagga, n’amagezi n’amaanyi, n’ekitiibwa, n’ettendo n’okwebazibwa! Ne ndyoka mpulira buli kitonde kyonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi ne wansi w’ensi ne mu nnyanja ne byonna ebigirimu nga bitendereza nti, Okutenderezebwa, n’ettendo, n’ekitiibwa, n’amaanyi by’Oyo atudde ku ntebe y’obwakabaka awamu n’Omwana gw’Endiga, Emirembe n’emirembe." (Okubikkulirwa 5:8-12). Bwe kityo kyeyoleka nti omulamwa omukulu ogw’omu makkati ogw’oluyimba lw’eggulu kwe kufa kwa Yesu Kristo okutangirira, n’"omusaayi" gwe yayiwa gwe yanunula nagwo abantu "okubaggya mu buli kika, na buli lulimi, na buli ggwanga." Singa ow’eddiini ya Unitarian oba Omu Christian Scientist oba ow’Enjigiriza Empya (New Theology) atuuka mu ggulu tewandibadde na luyimba lwa kuyimba. Oluyimba olw’ekitiibwa olw’ekibiina ekyo eky’abayimbi ekyewuunyisa yandiluwulidde ng’oluyimba "olw’omu ttale ly’ennyama." Yandiwulidde ekiwuubaalo ennyo n’alowooza nti ayingidde mu ntebe etali yiye. II. EKIGENDERERWA KY’OKUFA KWA YESU KRISTO Ebyo bimala ku bukulu obw’omusingi era obw’omu makkati obw’okufa kwe, oba obw’okuyiwa omusaayi gwe. Naye ekigendererwa ky’okuyiwa omusaayi gwe kyali ki? 1. Okusooka byonna, Bayibuli etubuulira lwatu era emirundi mingi, mu bigambo ebigolokofu ne mu bifaananyi ebitabalika eby’omu Ndagaano Enkadde, nti yafa ng’ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi mu kifo ky’abalala; kwe kugamba, nti ye, Omutuukirivu atuukiridde ddala, eyali agwanidde okuba omulamu, yafa mu kifo ky’abantu abatali batuukirivu abaali bagwanidde okufa. Ng’ekyokulabirako, tusoma mu Isaaya 53:5, "Naye yafumitibwa olw’okusobya kwaffe. Yabetentebwa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwaffe. Yeetikka ekibonerezo ffe tusobole okubeera n’emirembe. Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya." Ne mu lunyiriri olw’omunaana tusoma nti, "Mu kunyigirizibwa n’okusalirwa omusango yatwalibwa. Ani amanyi ku bye zadde lye? Yaggyibwa mu nsi y’abalamu, ng’akubiddwa olw’okusobya kw’abantu, bange." Ne mu lunyiriri 11 ne 12 tusoma nti, "Oluvannyuma lw’okubonaabona kw’obulamu bwe, bw’aliraba ku ebyo ebiva mu kubonaabona kwe, omutima gwe gulitereera. Era olw’ebyo bye yayitamu omuweereza wange omutuukirivu alireetera bangi okubalirwa obutuukirivu; era alyetikka obutali butuukirivu bwabwe. Kyendiva mmuwa ekifo eky’ekitiibwa mu bangi, era aligabira bangi omunyago kubanga yafuka obulamu bwe okutuusa okufa, n’abalirwa wamu n’abakozi b’ebibi. Era yeetikka ebibi by’abangi era ne yeegayiririra abakozi b’ebibi." Mu 1 Peetero, 3:18 tusoma nti, "Kubanga ddala Kristo yabonyaabonyezebwa olw’ebibi omulundi gumu, Omuntu Omutuukirivu ku lw’abatali batuukirivu, alyoke abaleete eri Katonda bwe yattibwa mu mubiri, kyokka n’abeera mulamu mu mwoyo." Ne mu 1 Peetero 2:24 tusoma nti, "Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe bwe yatufiirira ku musaalaba, naffe tulyoke tufe eri ekibi, tube abalamu eri obutuukirivu. Olw’ebiwundu bye, muwonyezebbwa." Kale amakulu g’ennyiriri zino n’endala nnyingi tegayinza kwewalibwa. Ziyigiriza mu lulimi omuntu yenna lw’atayinza kutegeera bubi (okuggyako ng’amaliridde obutalaba) nti okufa kwa Yesu Kristo kwali kutangirira mu kifo ky’abalala, kwe kugamba, Omutuukirivu, eyali agwanidde okuba omulamu, ng’afa mu kifo ky’abatali batuukirivu abaali bagwanidde okufa. Kwali, okukozesa ebigambo by’omuweereza w’e Los Angeles eyegaana nti akikkiriza, "okutangirira kw’omusaayi n’okusasula." Eno ye njigiriza ya Katonda ku Kutangirira, so si enjigiriza ya Unitarian ne Christian Science ku Kutangirira. 2. Naye ekyo si kye kyokka. Ate tuyigirizibwa nti yafa ng’omutango, kwe kugamba, okufa kwe kwe kwali omuwendo ogwasasulwa okununula abalala okuva mu kufa. Ye kennyini bw’agamba. Ebigambo bye bwe biri bwe bati, "Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi." Obulamu bwe bwe butaba mutango, kwe kugamba, bw’aba nga teyanunula balala okuva mu kufa ng’afa mu kifo kyabwe, kale yali musirusiru asinga bonna mu byafaayo byonna eby’ensi n’eggulu. Yali musirusiru oba yali mutango? Tewali muntu ayinza okugambibwa mu ngeri yonna ey’amazima nti akkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo ayinza okubuusabuusa ku kyakuddamu. 3. Naye n’ekyo si kye kyokka. Bayibuli etubuulira lwatu nti yafa ng’ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi, kwe kugamba, kwali kwesigamiziddwa ku kufa kwe, era ku kino kyokka, okusonyiyibwa ebibi kwe kwasobozesebwa era kwe kuweebwa aboonoonyi. Kino tukibuulirwa mu ssuula ya 53 eya Isaaya, gye twogeddeko dda. Mu lunyiriri 10 kyawandiikibwa nti, "Songa ate yali nteekateeka ya Mukama okumubetenta; ye (kwe kugamba, Mukama) era n’okumuleetera okubonaabona (mu bigambo ebyennyini, yamulwaza): Naye wadde nga Mukama yafuula obulamu bwe, okuba ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi, aliraba ezzadde, era obulamu bwe bulyongerwako, n’ebyo Mukama by’asiima biriraba omukisa mu mukono gwe." Kale amakulu g’"ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi" tegabuusibwabuusibwa eri omuntu yenna eyali asomye ku biweebwayo eby’Endagaano Enkadde. "Ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi" oba "ekiweebwayo olw’omusango," ge makulu amatuufu ag’ekigambo eky’Olwebbulaniya ekyavvuunulwa "ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi," kwali kufa kwa kisolo ekiweebwayo, olw’okufa okwo okusonyiyibwa ne kuweebwa aboonoonyi (Eby’Abaleevi 6:6-10, R. V.). Omwoyo Omutukuvu agamba butereevu mu Abaebbulaniya 9:22, mu bigambo amakulu gaabyo agatabuusibwabuusibwa era amaanyi gaabyo agatayinza kwewalibwa, "awatali kuyiwa musaayi tewabaawo kusonyiyibwa," era ebigambo byonna ebyetoolodde ekitundu ekyo biraga nti omusaayi, emisaayi gyonna egy’ebifaananyi by’Endagaano Enkadde nga ssaddaaka gye gyali gisonga, gwali musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo. Bwe kityo Ekigambo kya Katonda kirangirira nti awatali kuyiwa musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo tewali kusonyiyibwa kibi n’akatono. Tewali kusonyiyibwa n’akatono ebweru w’omusaayi gwa Kristo ogutangirira. Awatali musaayi gwa Kristo ogutangirira buli muntu mu lulyo lw’omuntu yandizikiridde emirembe gyonna. 4. Eky’okuna era okweyongerayo, Bayibuli eyigiriza nti Yesu Kristo yafa ng’omutango olw’ebibi byaffe. Katonda Kitaffe yawaayo Kristo Omwana okuba omutango olw’omusaayi gwe. Kwe kugamba nti Yesu Kristo, mu kuyiwa omusaayi gwe, y’ayita obusungu bwa Katonda obutukuvu ku kibi okukkakkana. Tusoma mu 1 Yokaana 4:10, "Mu kino mwe tutegeerera ddala okwagala kwennyini, kubanga teyakikola lwa kuba nti ffe twali twagala Katonda, naye ye yennyini ye yatwagala, n’awaayo Omwana we ng’omutango olw’ebibi byaffe." Ne tusoma mu Abaruumi 3:25, 26, "Katonda yaweereza Kristo okuba omutango, bwe tukkiriza Kristo olw’omusaayi gwe yayiwa. Alaga obutuukirivu bwe mu kugumiikiriza ebibi ebyakolebwa edda, be bantu abaayonoona mu biseera biri eby’edda. (26) Kino kiraga Katonda bw’alaga okwaniriza kw’alina eri abantu mu biro bino, bwe baba n’okukkiriza mu Yesu." Amakulu g’ebigambo bino nago gatangaala ng’emisana. Ebigambo bibiri eby’Oluyonaani mu bitundu bino byombi si bye bimu ddala (hilasmos ne hilasterion) naye biva ku kikolo kimu. Ekigambo ekikozesebwa mu 1 Yokaana 4:10 kiri hilasmos ate ekikozesebwa mu Abaruumi 3:25 kiri hilasterion. Amakulu agaweebwa ekisooka mu Thayer’s Dictionary of New Testament Greek, ekitabo ekyesigibwa ennyo, gali "ekikkakkanya." Amakulu agaweebwa mu kitabo kye kimu eky’ebigambo ku kigambo eky’okubiri gali "ssaddaaka etangirira." Bwe kityo endowooza eri mu bitundu byombi eri nti okufa kwa Yesu Kristo kwali "mutango," "ssaddaaka etangirira," "ekikkakkanya" obusungu bwa Katonda obutukuvu ku kibi, oba mu bigambo ebirala, nti Yesu, mu kuyiwa omusaayi gwe, y’ayita obusungu bwa Katonda ku ffe ng’aboonoonyi okukkakkana. Obutukuvu bwa Katonda n’okukyawa ekibi okubuvaamu, nga buli ngeri endala ey’embala ye, bya ddala era birina okweyoleka. Obusungu bwe ku kibi bulina okukuba awalala, oba ku mwonoonyi yennyini oba ku amuddira mu kifo mu ngeri ey’amateeka. Bwakuba ku Yesu Kristo, eyamuddira mu kifo mu ngeri ey’amateeka. Nga bwe tusoma mu Isaaya 53:6, "Ffenna twawaba ng’endiga; buli omu ku ffe n’akwata ekkubo lye; Mukama n’amuteekako obutali butuukirivu bwaffe ffenna." Ekigambo ekyavvuunulwa "n’amuteekako," okusinziira ku bigambo ebiri ku mabbali ga Revised Version, kitegeeza mu bigambo ebyennyini nti, "n’akigwisa ku ye." Mu bigambo ebyennyini n’okusingawo kitegeeza nti, "n’akireetera okumukuba." Bwe tukisoma bwe tutyo, Katonda ky’agamba kiri nti, "Ffenna twawaba ng’endiga; buli omu ku ffe n’akwata ekkubo lye; Mukama n’akireetera okukuba ku ye (kwe kugamba, ku Mukama Yesu) obutali butuukirivu bwaffe ffenna." Ne mu lunyiriri olw’omunaana olw’essuula y’emu tuyigirizibwa nti "okukubibwa okwali kugwanidde" abalala kwagwa ku ye, n’olw’ekyo "n’aggyibwa mu nsi y’abalamu." Okufa kwa Yesu Kristo kulina ensibuko yaakwo esooka mu bwetaavu bw’obutukuvu bwa Katonda. Eno ye njigiriza ya Bayibuli, so si enjigiriza ya Unitarian ne Christian Science ku kutangirira. Enjigiriza eno etera okunyoolebwa n’okusekererwa nga bagamba nti "Katonda, omuntu ow’okusooka omutukuvu, yatwala ebibi by’omuntu, omuntu ow’okubiri omusobya, n’abiteeka ku Yesu Kristo, omuntu ow’okusatu ataliiko musango," era ne bawakanya nti kino tekyandibadde kya bwenkanya. Nedda; kino tekyandibadde kya bwenkanya, era si njigiriza ya Bayibuli n’akatono, kubanga Bayibuli eyigiriza lwatu nti Yesu Kristo teyali "muntu ow’okusatu," wabula yali Katonda yennyini, era yali muntu yennyini, kale si muntu wa kusatu n’akatono, wabula ye muntu ow’okusooka era ye muntu ow’okubiri, era enjigiriza eri nti Katonda yennyini, omuntu ow’okusooka eyanyiizibwa, adda mu kifo ky’ekikolwa kye eky’okubonereza, ky’andiyiseemu okulaga ekintu kye kimu, n’ateekawo ekikolwa kye eky’okutangirira mw’alagira okukyawa kwe ekibi; nti Katonda, mu kifo ky’okussa ebibi by’omwonoonyi ku mwonoonyi, yeetikka yekka ekibonerezo. Kino ddala kisingako ku bwenkanya, kwe kwagala okwewuunyisa. 5. Okwongera ku ekyo, Bayibuli etuyigiriza nti Yesu Kristo yafa okutununula okuva mu kikolimo ky’amateeka ng’ekikolimo ekyo yakyetikka yennyini. Tusoma mu Abaggalatiya 3:10, "Naye abo abafugibwa ebikolwa eby’amateeka, bafugibwa kikolimo; kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti, Buli ataagobererenga byonna ebiwandiikiddwa mu kitabo ky’amateeka, akolimiddwa." Kale buli omu ku ffe ali wansi w’ekikolimo ky’amateeka agamenyeddwa, kubanga tewali n’omu ku ffe eyagoberera "byonna ebiwandiikiddwa mu kitabo ky’amateeka." Naye mu lunyiriri olwa 13 tusoma nti, "Kristo yatununula okuva mu kikolimo ky’amateeka, bwe yafuuka ekikolimo ku lwaffe (mu bigambo ebyo ddala, mu kifo kyaffe): kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti, Akolimiddwa buli awanikiddwa ku muti." Olw’okufa kwe ku musaalaba yatununula okuva mu kikolimo kye twali tusaanidde, ng’ekikolimo ekyo akyetikka yennyini. Ddala kuno "kutangirira kwa musaayi n’okusasula." 6. Bayibuli amazima ago gamu egateeka ne mu ngeri endala, kwe kugamba nti Yesu Kristo yafa ng’ekiweebwayo kyaffe eky’Okuyitako—kwe kugamba, omusaayi gwe ogwayiika gubeere omusingi Katonda kw’asinziira okutuyitako n’atusonyiwa. Tusoma mu 1 Abakkolinso 5:7, "Kristo ye ndiga eyaweebwayo ng’ekiweebwayo eky’Okuyitako ku lwaffe." Kaakano ekiweebwayo eky’Okuyitako kye kyali ne kye kyategeeza tukiyiga mu Okuva 12:12, 13, Mukama we yagambira abaana ba Isirayiri ng’Okuyitako kutandikibwawo, "Kubanga mu kiro ekyo ndiyita mu nsi ya Misiri, nditta buli kibereberye kyonna mu nsi y’e Misiri, abantu era n’ebisolo; era bakatonda bonna ab’omu Misiri ndibasalira omusango. Nze Mukama. Omusaayi ke kaliba akabonero akalaga ennyumba mwe muli; era bwe ndiraba omusaayi, nga mbayitako; so n’okuzikirira kwe ndireeta ku Bamisiri mmwe tekulibakwatako." Era ne mu lunyiriri olwa 23 olw’essuula y’emu tusoma nti, "Kubanga Mukama ajja kuyita awo ng’agenda okutta Abamisiri; kale bw’anaalaba omusaayi ku mwango gw’oluggi waggulu ne ku mwango mu mbiriizi z’oluggi, oluggi olwo Mukama ajja kuluyitako, era tajja kukkiriza oyo azikiriza kuyingira mu nnyumba zammwe n’okubatta." Pawulo bwe yawandiika ebigambo bye ebyo byonna yali abirowoozaako, era bwe yagamba nti Kristo kye kiweebwayo kyaffe eky’Okuyitako, awatali kubuusabuusa yali ategeeza nti omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo ogwayiika gwe musingi, era gwe musingi gwokka, Katonda kw’asinziira okutuyitako n’atusonyiwa. III. EBYAVA MU KUFA OKW’OKUTANGIRIRA Kale tulabye ebigendererwa eby’ekisa era eby’ekitiibwa eby’Okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’Okutangirira. Kiki ekyava mu kufa okwo? Ebyavaamu bisingako n’okuba eby’ekitiibwa. Enkya ya leero nsobola okubyogerako ekitundu kyokka. 1. Ekisooka ekyava mu kufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira kwe kuba nti omutango guteekeddwawo ku lw’ensi yonna. Tusoma mu 1 Yokaana 2:2, "Ye, ye mutango olw’ebibi byaffe, naye si lwa bibi byaffe byokka, wabula ne ku lw’ebibi by’abantu bonna." Kino kitegeeza bulungi nti olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo waliwo omusingi Katonda kw’asobola okukwatira ensi yonna n’okusaasira, era kw’agikwatira n’okusaasira. Byonna Katonda by’akolera omuntu yenna mu kusaasira bisinziira ku kufa kwa Kristo. Katonda yandisobodde okusaasira omuntu yenna olw’okufa kwa Kristo kwokka. Okusaasira Katonda kw’alaga omuvumi asinga obubi oba atakkiriza Katonda asinga okweraga, kusinziira ku kufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira. 2. Eky’okubiri, olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira abantu bonna bafuna okuzuukira okuva mu bafu. Tusoma mu Abaruumi 5:18, "Kale ng’abantu bonna bwe baasalirwa omusango olw’ekibi ekimu, (kwe kugamba, ekibi kya Adamu) bwe kityo n’olw’ekikolwa ekimu eky’obutuukirivu (kwe kugamba, ekikolwa kya Kristo eky’obutuukirivu bwe yafiira ku musaalaba ng’agondera Katonda by’ayagala) abantu bonna mwe baaweerwa obutuukirivu ne bafuna obulamu." Era tugambibwa mu 1 Abakkolinso 15:22, "Kuba ng’abantu bonna bwe baafa olwa Adamu, era bwe batyo bonna balifuulibwa abalamu olwa Kristo." Omutume Pawulo mu ssuula eyo yonna ayogera ku kuzuukira kw’omubiri, so si ku bulamu obutaggwaawo, era wano ayigiriza bulungi nti nga buli mwana wa Adamu bw’afiirwa obulamu (obulamu obw’omubiri—laba Olubereberye 3:19) mu Adamu eyasooka, bw’atyo ne mu Yesu Kristo, Adamu ow’okubiri, afuna okuzuukira okuva mu bafu, olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira. Buli muntu, atakkiriza asinga obubi wamu n’omukkiriza asinga okwewaayo, alizuukizibwa lumu okuva mu bafu kubanga Kristo yafa mu kifo kye. Oba okuzuukira kw’afuna olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo kuliba "kuzuukira kwa bulamu" oba "kuzuukira kwa musango," "ensonyi n’okuswazibwa okutaggwaawo" (Yokaana 5:28, 29; Danyeri 12:2) kisinziira ddala ku ngeri omuntu gy’atwalamu Kristo oyo mw’afunira okuzuukira. 3. Olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira, bonna abakkiriza Yesu Kristo basonyiyibwa ebibi byabwe byonna. Tusoma mu Abaefeso 1:7, "Mu oyo (kwe kugamba, mu Yesu Kristo) mwe tununulibwa olw’omusaayi gwe, ne tusonyiyibwa ebibi, ng’obugagga bw’ekisa kye bwe buli." Olw’okuba Yesu Kristo yafa ng’omutango ogumala ddala olw’ebibi byaffe, okusonyiyibwa ekibi si kintu abakkiriza kye balina okukolerera okukifuna; kye kintu omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo kye gwafuna dda era okukkiriza kwaffe kwe kwakyetwalira dda; "tulina okusonyiyibwa," twasonyiyibwa. Buli akkiriza Yesu Kristo asonyiyibwa buli kibi kye yali akoze oba ky’alikola, kubanga Yesu Kristo yayiwa omusaayi gwe mu kifo kye. Olw’okufa kwa Kristo okw’okutangirira, bonna abamukkiriza, wadde edda "baali balabe," kaakano "batabaganyizibwa ne Katonda olw’okufa kw’Omwana we." Nga bwe tusoma mu Abaruumi 5:10, "bwe twali tukyali balabe ba Katonda twatabaganyizibwa naye mu kufa kw’Omwana we." Kwe kugamba, obulabe wakati wa Katonda n’omwonoonyi buggyiddwawo, oba, nga Pawulo bw’akyogera mu Abakkolosaayi 1:20, Kristo "Yaleetawo emirembe olw’omusaayi gwe, ogwayika ku musaalaba," oba, nga bw’akyogera mu lunyiriri oluddako oluvannyuma lw’olumu, Abakkolosaayi 1:22, Kristo "yatabaganya" abakkiriza "olw’okufa kwe mu mubiri gwe." Waliwo olugero olw’omusumba omwesigwa mu Bungereza eyategeezebwa nti omu ku b’ekibiina kye yali ali kumpi kufa. Yali mukazi mulungi, naye yayanguwa okugenda gy’ali okwogera naye. Bwe yatuula okumpi n’omukazi oyo eyali afa, yamugamba mpola naye mu bwesimbu, "Bangamba nti tosigazza bbanga ddene kubeera mulamu." "Nedda," bwe yaddamu, "Mmanyi nti sisigazza." "Bangamba nti oboolyawo tojja kukeesa budde." "Nedda," bwe yaddamu, "Sisuubira kukeesa budde." Awo n’amugamba n’obunyiikivu, "Otabaganye ne Katonda?" N’addamu nti, "Nedda, saatabagana naye." "Era totya kusisinkana Katonda nga totabaganye naye?" "Nedda, n’akatono," bwe yaddamu mu kkakkamu. Era n’addamu okumugamba, "Otegeera kye njogera? Otegeera nti oli kumpi kufa?" "Yee." "Otegeera nti oboolyawo tojja kukeesa budde?" "Yee." "Era totabaganye ne Katonda?" "Nedda." "Era totya kusisinkana Katonda?" "Nedda, n’akatono." Waaliwo ekintu mu ngeri y’omukazi oyo ekyamuleetera okuwulira nti waaliwo ekintu emabega w’ebigambo bye, n’amugamba nti, "Otegeeza ki?" N’addamu nti, "Mmanyi nti nfa. Mmanyi nti ndi kumpi nnyo okufa. Mmanyi nti sijja kukeesa budde. Mmanyi nti ŋŋenda kusisinkana Katonda mangu, naye sitawaanyizibwa n’akatono, kubanga mmanyi nti saabadde na kwetaaga kutabagana na Katonda, kubanga Yesu Kristo yatabaganya Katonda nange emyaka lukumi mu lunaana egiyise, olw’okufa kwe ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo, era kaakano nwummulira mu mirembe Yesu Kristo gye yaleetawo dda." Omukazi oyo yali mutuufu: tewali muntu yeetaaga kwetabaganya ye kennyini ne Katonda; Yesu Kristo yaleetawo dda emirembe olw’okufa kwe okw’okutangirira, era kye tulina okukola kyokka kwe kuyingira mu mirembe Yesu Kristo gye yatuleetera, era tuyingira mu mirembe egyo nga tukkiriza bukkiriza Oyo eyaleeta emirembe olw’okufa kwe ku musaalaba. Omulimu gwa Yesu Kristo gwali mulimu mujjuvu era ogutuukiridde. Tewali kya kugwongerako. Tetusobola kugwongerako kintu kyonna, era tetwetaaga kugwongerako kintu kyonna. Yesu Kristo "Yaleetawo emirembe olw’omusaayi gwe, ogwayika ku musaalaba." 4. Ekyokuna ekyava mu kufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira kwe kuba nti olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira bonna abamukkiriza baweebwa obutuukirivu. Tusoma mu Abaruumi 5:9, "twaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’omusaayi gwe." Okuweebwa obutuukirivu kusinga okusonyiyibwa. Okusonyiyibwa kwa ludda lumu, kwe kuggyibwako ebibi byaffe, nga kirabikira mu Katonda okutuyisa nga abataayonoonangako. Okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwa ludda lulala era kwa maanyi, kwe kutubala nga batuukirivu ddala, kwe kutuwa obutuukirivu bwa Katonda obutuukiridde obuli mu Yesu Kristo; si kutuyisa buyisa nga abataayonoonangako, wabula kutubala ng’abambadde obutuukirivu obutuukiridde. Olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira, Yesu Kristo n’abantu be bawaanyisiganya ddala ebifo. Mu kufa kwe ku musaalaba, Yesu Kristo yatwala ekifo kyaffe eky’okusalirwa omusango mu maaso ga Katonda, era mu kaseera ke tumukkiriza tuyingira mu kifo kye eky’okukkirizibwa ddala mu maaso ga Katonda. Nga Pawulo bw’akyogera mu 2 Abakkolinso 5:21, "Kubanga oyo ataamanya kibi, yafuuka ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu." Yesu Kristo yayingira mu kifo kyaffe mu kikolimo ne mu kugaanibwa, era mu kaseera ke tumukkiriza tuyingira mu kifo kye eky’okukkirizibwa ddala, oba nga omulala bwe yakyogera: "Kumpi, kumpi nnyo ne Katonda, Siyinza kusingawo kumpi; Kubanga mu Mwana we, Ndi kumpi nga ye bw’ali. Omwagalwa, omwagalwa nnyo wa Katonda, Siyinza kusingawo kwagalwa; Kubanga mu Mwana we, Njagalibwa nga ye bw’ayagalibwa." 5. Ate era, olw’okutangirira okujjuvu Yesu Kristo kwe yakola ng’ayiwa omusaayi gwe, olw’okufa kwe okw’okutangirira ku musaalaba, buli amukkiriza asobola okuyingira n’obuvumu mu kifo ekitukuvu, mu maaso ga Katonda gennyini. Nga bwe kyogerwa mu Abaebbulaniya 10:19, 20, "Kale abooluganda nga bwe tulina obuvumu okuyingira mu Watukuvu w’Awatukuvu (kwe kugamba, mu maaso ga Katonda gennyini) olw’omusaayi gwa Yesu, eyatuggulirawo ekkubo eriggya era eddamu eriyita mu lutimbe, gwe mubiri gwe, kale nga bwe tulina Kabona Asinga Obukulu nga y’afuga ennyumba ya Katonda, tusembere awali Katonda n’omwoyo ogw’amazima ogujjudde okukkiriza nga tulina emitima egitukuzibbwa okuva mu ndowooza embi, era nga n’emibiri gyaffe ginaazibbwa n’amazzi amatukuvu." Woowe, abamu ku ffe nga tulwawo okujja mu maaso ga Katonda bwe tulowooza ku bunene n’obungi bw’ebibi byaffe, era bwe tulowooza nga Katonda bw’ali omutukuvu, nga ne basseraafi bennyini (abo "abaaka," abaaka olw’obutukuvu bwabwe obungi) bwe babikka amaaso gaabwe n’ebigere byabwe mu maaso ge era nga tebalekaayo kukoowoola nti "Mutukuvu, mutukuvu, mutukuvu, Mukama Katonda Ayinzabyonna" (Isaaya 6:2, 3). "Katonda Mutukuvu," bwe tulowooza. "Yee." "Nange ndi mwonoonyi." "Yee." Naye olw’ekiweebwayo kya Kristo eky’ekitalo "omulundi ogumu" "nfuuliddwa omutuukirivu emirembe gyonna," era olw’omusaayi ogwo ogw’omuwendo ennyo era ogumala Katonda, nsobola okukumbira n’obuvumu mu maaso ga Katonda gennyini, ne nnyimusa amaaso gange agatabikkiddwa ne ntunula mu maaso ge, ne mmuyita "Kitange," ne nfuka mu maaso ge buli kye njagala mu mutima gwange. Woowe, omusaayi ogw’ekitalo! 6. Naye ebyo si byonna. Olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira, abo abamukkiriza balibeera naye emirembe gyonna. Nga Pawulo bw’akyogera bulungi mu 1 Basessaloniika 5:10, "eyatufiirira ka tube nga tuli balamu oba nga tufudde, (kwe kugamba, ku kujja kwe), tulyoke tubeere balamu wamu naye." 7. Ate era, olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira, bonna abamukkiriza bafuna ekisuubizo eky’obusika obutaggwaawo. Kino kye tugambibwa mu Abaebbulaniya 9:15, "Noolwekyo Kristo ye mutabaganya mu ndagaano empya, okufa bwe kwabaawo olw’okununulibwa okuva mu byonoono eby’omu ndagaano eyasooka, abo abaayitibwa ab’obusika obutaggwaawo balyoke baweebwe ekisuubizo." Nandyagadde nnyo okuba n’obudde okukyogerako mu bujjuvu. 8. Waliwo ebirala ebyava mu kufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira ebikwata ku Setaani ne bamalayika be, bye tutalina budde kwogerako. Ekintu kimu kyokka ekirala ku byava mu kufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira nga bwe kikwata ku bitonde ebirabika. Katonda atuyigiriza nti olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo, ebitonde ebirabika—"ebintu byonna, eby’ensi n’eby’omu ggulu"—bitabaganyizibwa ne Katonda. Bino bye bigambo bye, "Katonda yasiima okutuukiriza byonna mu ye, (kwe kugamba, mu Yesu Kristo) era mu ye ebintu byonna bitabaganyizibwa gy’ali. Yaleetawo emirembe olw’omusaayi gwe, ogwayika ku musaalaba, alyoke atabaganye eby’ensi n’eby’omu ggulu." (Abakkolosaayi 1:19, 20). Bino bigambo bya kitalo. Bitugamba nti okufa kwa Yesu Kristo kukwatagana n’ebitonde ebirabika, n’ebintu eby’ensi n’eby’omu ggulu, era ne ku ffe n’ebibi byaffe. Ebitonde ebirabika byawukana ne Katonda olw’ekibi (Abaruumi 8:20, R. V.; Olubereberye 3:18). Si nsi yokka, wabula n’eggulu, ekibi kyalirumba ne kirijama (Abaefeso 6:12, R. V.; Abaebbulaniya 9:23, 24). Olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo obujama buno buggyibwawo. Nga omusaayi gwa ssaddaaka ey’Endagaano Enkadde bwe gwatwalibwanga mu Watukuvu w’Awatukuvu, ekifaananyi ky’eggulu, bw’atyo ne Kristo yatwala omusaayi gwa ssaddaaka esinga mu ggulu mwennyini n’alitukuza. "ebintu byonna . . . eby’ensi n’eby’omu ggulu" kaakano bitabaganyizibwa ne Katonda. "Ebitonde birifuulibwa bya ddembe okuva mu kufugibwa okuvunda ne bigabanira wamu n’abaana ba Katonda ekitiibwa eky’okuba mu ddembe." (Abaruumi 8:21). "tulindirira obwengula obuggya n’ensi empya omuli obutuukirivu" (2 Peetero 3:13). Okutangirira kwa Yesu Kristo kubuna wonna—kusukkulumye nnyo ku bufirosoofo bwaffe obw’obuntu. Tukyatandika butandisi okutegeera omusaayi ogwayiika ku Kalvaliyo kye gutegeeza. Ekibi kibi kya ntiisa nnyo, kizikiriza era kibuna wonna okusinga bwe twali tulowooza, naye omusaayi gwa Kristo gulina amaanyi n’obuyinza, obujjuvu bwabyo obulibikkulibwa ebiseera eby’olubeerera byokka.

fields.title: Enjigiriza Eyawula Abaprotestanti: Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza
fields.body_html:
"Abooluganda, mumpulirize! Mu muntu ono Yesu okusonyiyibwa ebibi mwe kubuuliddwa. Kino nga tekiyinzika mu mateeka ga Musa. Buli amukkiriza n’amwesiga aggyibwako omusango gw’ekibi, n’aweebwa obutuukirivu."—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:38, 39.

"Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye."—Abaruumi 4:5.

Bino bitundu bibiri ebyewuunyisa, era essuula eno ejja kwemalira ku kubinnyonnyola. Omulamwa gwaffe enkya ya leero gwe guno: Enjigiriza Eyawula Abaprotestanti: Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza. Enjigiriza y’Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza ye yazaala Enkyukakyuka (Reformation). Ne leero y’emu ku njigiriza enkulu ez’Okukkiriza kw’Enjiri. Enjigiriza eno, wadde Pawulo ye yasooka okuginnyonnyola mu bujjuvu n’agiggumiza buli kiseera, eyita mu Bayibuli yonna okuva mu Olubereberye okutuuka mu Okubikkulirwa. Mu kitabo kya Bayibuli ekisooka, ekitabo ky’Olubereberye, mwe tusoma nti, "Ibulaamu n’akkiriza Mukama, n’akimubalira okuba obutuukirivu." (Olubereberye 15:6.) Mu bigambo bino, mu kitabo kya Bayibuli ekisookera ddala, mwe tusanga ensigo y’enjigiriza yonna ey’ekisa era ey’omuwendo ey’Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza.

I. OKUWEEBWA OBUTUUKIRIVU KYE KI?

Ekintu ekisooka kye tulina okutegeera obulungi kwe kumanya okuweebwa obutuukirivu kye kiri ddala. Wano bangi we bawabira nga basoma amazima gano amakulu. Waliwo amakulu abiri agawukana ddala ag’ebigambo "okuwa obutuukirivu" n’"okuweebwa obutuukirivu." Amakulu amu agagamba nti okuwa obutuukirivu kwe kufuula omuntu omutuukirivu, n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwe kufuulibwa omutuukirivu. Amakulu amalala agagamba nti "okuwa obutuukirivu" kwe kubala, kulangirira oba kulaga nti omuntu mutuukirivu, n’"okuweebwa obutuukirivu" kwe kulangirirwa oba kubalibwa nga mutuukirivu. Ku makulu gano abiri agawukana, amasomero abiri ag’endowooza we gaawukanira. Makulu ki amatuufu? Engeri y’okumanya amakulu g’ekigambo kyonna mu Bayibuli kwe kwekenneenya ebitundu byonna ekigambo ekyo n’ebiva mu kyo mwe bisangibwa. Omuntu yenna bw’anaayita mu Bayibuli, Endagaano Enkadde n’Empya, n’asoma n’obwegendereza ebitundu byonna ekigambo "okuwa obutuukirivu" n’ebiva mu kyo mwe bisangibwa, ajja kukizuula nti awatali kubuusabuusa, mu ngeri Bayibuli gy’ekozesaamu ekigambo, "okuwa obutuukirivu" tekitegeeza kufuula muntu mutuukirivu, wabula kumubala nga mutuukirivu, kumulangirira nga mutuukirivu, oba kulaga nti mutuukirivu. Omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda Katonda bw’amubala nga mutuukirivu. Kino kirabikira, okugeza, mu ssuula ey’okuna ey’Abaruumi, olunyiriri olwa 2 okutuuka ku lwa 8, R. V. "Singa Ibulayimu yaweebwa obutuukirivu lwa bikolwa, yandyenyumirizza, naye si eri Katonda. Ebyawandiikibwa bitugamba bitya? Ibulayimu yakkiriza Katonda ne kimubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu. Omuntu bw’akola omulimu, asasulwa empeera ye. Empeera gy’aweebwa, teba kirabo. Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye. Kabaka Dawudi naye yayogera kye kimu ku muntu ono Katonda gw’awa obutuukirivu obutavudde mu bikolwa bye ng’agamba nti: Baweereddwa omukisa, abasonyiyiddwa ebyonoono byabwe, ne baggyibwako ebibi byabwe. Aweereddwa omukisa omuntu, Mukama gw’atalibalira kibi." Kyeyoleka bulungi okuva mu kitundu kino, era ne mu bitundu ebirala bingi, nti omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu Katonda bw’amubala nga mutuukirivu, ka kibe nti empisa ze n’enneeyisa ye byali bitya. Oluvannyuma tujja kulaba nti okuweebwa obutuukirivu kusinga okusonyiyibwa obusonyiyibwa.

II. ABANTU BAWEEBWA BATYA OBUTUUKIRIVU?

Kaakano tutuuse ku kibuuzo eky’okubiri, era ekikulu ennyo okusinga byonna: Abantu baweebwa batya obutuukirivu? Okutwalira awamu waliwo endowooza bbiri ezikontana ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu: emu egamba nti abantu baweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa byabwe bo, kwe kugamba, olw’ekintu kye bakola bo bennyini. Endowooza eno eyinza okwogerwa mu ngeri nnyingi. Ebikolwa ebirungi abantu bye boogerako ng’omusingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu bayinza okuba empisa zaabwe ennungi, oba okukuuma kwabwe Etteeka Erya Zaabu, oba ekintu ekiringa ekyo. Oba biyinza okuba ebikolwa by’eddiini, gamba ng’okwebonereza olw’ebibi, okwogera essaala, okwegatta ku kkanisa, okugenda mu kkanisa, okubatizibwa, oba okulya ku Ky’Ekiro kya Mukama, oba okutuukiriza emirimu emirala egy’eddiini. Naye bino byonna bikomekkereza kye kimu: kintu ffe kye tukola ffe bennyini ekireeta okuweebwa obutuukirivu; ebikolwa byaffe ffe, ebikolwa bye tukola, bye bitwalibwa ng’omusingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Endowooza endala ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu egamba nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu, si lwa bikolwa byaffe mu ngeri yonna, wabula olw’omulimu gw’omulala gwokka, kwe kugamba, olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo; nti ebikolwa byaffe tebirina kakwate na kuweebwa butuukirivu bwaffe, wabula tuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’omulimu gwa Kristo ogw’okutangirira gwe yamaliriza era ogujjuvu, olw’okufa kwe ku Musaalaba ku lwaffe; era nti kye tulina okukola ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu bwaffe kwe kukwetwalira obwetwalizi nga twesiga bwesizi Oyo eyakola okutangirira. Ndowooza ki entuufu? Tujja kugenda butereevu mu Bayibuli okufuna eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo kino ekikulu ennyo.

1. Ekitundu ekisooka eky’okuddamu tujja kukisanga mu Abaruumi 3:20, "Kubanga tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka. Mu mateeka mwe tutegeerera ddala ekibi." Wano kyogerwa bulungi nnyo nti tetuweebwa butuukirivu lwa kukuuma mateeka ga Katonda, ka gabe amateeka ga Musa oba amateeka amalala gonna, era nti amateeka gaaweebwa, si kutuleetera kuweebwa butuukirivu, wabula okutumanyisa ekibi, kwe kugamba, okututuusa ku kutegeera nti twetaaga okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ekisa. Kyogerwa bulungi wano nti tewali muntu aweebwa butuukirivu lwa bikolwa bya mateeka. Amazima ago gamu amakulu gasangibwa mu Abaggalatiya 2:16: "Kyokka tukimanyi bulungi nti omuntu taweebwa butuukirivu lwa kugondera mateeka, wabula abufuna lwa kukkiriza Yesu Kristo, era naffe kyetwava tukkiriza Yesu Kristo tulyoke tuweebwe obutuukirivu olw’okumukkiriza so si lwa kugondera mateeka. Kubanga tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa eby’amateeka." Okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa byaffe byonna tekisoboka. Tekisoboka kubanga okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka, oba olw’ekintu kyonna kye tusobola okukola, tuteekwa okukuuma amateeka ga Katonda mu bujjuvu. Amateeka gasaba obuwulize obutuukiridde ng’omusingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Gagamba nti, "Buli ataagobererenga byonna ebiwandiikiddwa mu kitabo ky’amateeka, akolimiddwa." (Abaggalatiya 3:10.). Naye tewali n’omu ku ffe yakuuma amateeka ga Katonda mu bujjuvu, era mu kaseera ke tumenya etteeka lya Katonda mu kantu konna, okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa kufuuka ekitasoboka ddala. Kale ku bikwata ku mateeka ga Katonda, buli omu ku ffe ali "wansi w’ekikolimo," era bwe tuba ab’okuweebwa obutuukirivu n’akatono, tuteekwa okunoonya ekkubo eddala ery’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, so si kukuuma mateeka ga Katonda. Katonda teyawa muntu mateeka ng’asuubira oba ng’ayagala agakuume aweebwe obutuukirivu olw’ekyo. Yabawa amateeka okubaleetera okumanya nti boonoonyi, okuziba emimwa gy’abantu, n’okubatuusa eri Kristo. Oba, nga Pawulo bw’akyogera mu Abaruumi 3:19, 20, "Tumanyi nga buli kyawandiikibwa mu mateeka, kyawandiikibwa ku lw’abo abafugibwa amateeka. Amateeka malambulukufu ku nsonga ezo, omuntu yenna aleme okwekwasa ensonga yonna, ate era ne Katonda okwongera okulaga ng’ensi yonna bwe yasobya. Kubanga tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka. Mu mateeka mwe tutegeerera ddala ekibi." Wadde ebigambo bino ebya Katonda bitegeerekeka bulungi bwe bityo, eky’ewuunyisa kiri nti leero waliwo bangi ababuulira amateeka ng’ekkubo ery’obulokozi. Naye bwe babuulira bwe batyo baba babuulira ekkubo ery’obulokozi eddala, eritali eryo eryateekebwawo mu kigambo kya Katonda yennyini.

2. Ekitundu eky’okubiri eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo ky’engeri gye tuweebwamu obutuukirivu tukisanga mu Abaruumi 3:24. "Kyokka twaweebwa obutuukirivu bwa buwa olw’ekisa kye ekiri mu kununulibwa okuli mu Yesu Kristo;" Ekigambo ekyavvuunulwa "bwa buwa" mu kitundu kino kitegeeza ng’ekirabo eky’obwereere, era olunyiriri lutugamba nti abantu baweebwa obutuukirivu ng’ekirabo eky’obwereere olw’ekisa kya Katonda (kwe kugamba, okusiima kwa Katonda kwe tutasaanira) okuyita mu (kwe kugamba, nga kusinziira ku) kununulibwa okuli mu Kristo Yesu. Mu bigambo ebirala, okuweebwa obutuukirivu tekusinziira ku kusaanira kwonna okuli mu ffe, tekusinziira ku kintu kyonna kye twakola; tetuweebwa butuukirivu lwa bikolwa byaffe wadde olw’empisa zaffe. Okuweebwa obutuukirivu kirabo kya bwereere Katonda ky’awa awatali kusasulwa n’akatono. Omukutu ekirabo kino eky’obwereere mwe kiyita kwe kununulibwa okuli mu Kristo Yesu. Oluvannyuma tujja kulaba nti kino kitegeeza olw’omuwendo Kristo gwe yasasula okutununula, kwe kugamba, okuyiwa omusaayi gwe ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo.

3. Kino kitutuusa ku kitundu eky’okusatu eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo, abantu baweebwa batya obutuukirivu. Ekitundu kino eky’okusatu eky’okuddamu tukisanga mu Abaruumi 5:9, "Kale obanga twaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’omusaayi gwe, alitulokola okuva mu busungu bwa Katonda." Wano tugambibwa mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu, oba tubalibwa nga batuukirivu "olw’," oba okusinga mu bigambo ebyo ddala, "mu," musaayi gwa Kristo, kwe kugamba, olw’okufa kwa Kristo okw’omutango. Ffenna twali wansi w’ekikolimo ky’amateeka ga Katonda agaamenyebwa, kubanga ffenna twali tugamenye, naye bwe yafa mu kifo kyaffe ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo, Mukama waffe Yesu "Kristo yatununula okuva mu kikolimo ky’amateeka, bwe yafuuka ekikolimo ku lwaffe, kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti, Akolimiddwa buli awanikiddwa ku muti." (Abaggalatiya 3:13.) Oba, nga Peetero bw’akyogera mu 1 Peetero 2:24, "Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe." Oba nga Pawulo bw’akyogera nate mu 2 Abakkolinso 5:21, "Kubanga oyo ataamanya kibi, (Katonda) yamufuula ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu." Tujja kufuna omukisa okuddamu okwogera ku kitundu kino oluvannyuma. Kye njagala mukirabe kyokka mu kiseera kino kiri nti tubalibwa nga batuukirivu olw’okuba Yesu Kristo yayimirira mu kifo kyaffe, olw’okutwala ekifo kye twali tusaanidde; ku musaalaba. Omusingi gumu gwokka ogw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu gwe musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo ogwayiika. Kya lwatu nti enjigiriza eno ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kwa Christian Science, era ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kw’ebingi ebiyitibwa New Theology, era ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kwa New Thought ne Theosophy, era ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kwa Unitarian, naye kwe kuyigiriza kw’Ekigambo kya Katonda. Okuyigiriza kuno kwe kumu tukusanga nga kwogerwa bulungi nnabbi Isaaya emyaka lusanvu nga Mukama waffe tannazaalibwa, mu Isaaya 53:6, w’agamba nti, "Ffenna twawaba ng’endiga; buli omu ku ffe n’akwata ekkubo lye; Mukama n’ateeka (mu bigambo ebyo ddala, n’akikubya) ku ye (kwe kugamba, ku Mukama Yesu) obutali butuukirivu bwaffe ffenna." Kino kinywereze bulungi mu birowoozo byo, nti omusingi gwokka, naye ogumala ddala, abantu kwe basinziira okuweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda gwe musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo ogwayiika, Yesu Kristo gwe yawaayo ng’okutangirira olw’ebibi byaffe era Katonda Kitaffe gwe yakkiriza ng’okutangirira okumala ddala.

4. Ekitundu eky’okuna eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo, abantu baweebwa batya obutuukirivu, tukisanga mu Abaruumi 3:26, "Kino kyali kulaga, nkyogera, obutuukirivu (kwe kugamba, obwa Katonda) bwe mu kiseera kino: alyoke (kwe kugamba, Katonda) abeere omutuukirivu ye yennyini, era oyo awa obutuukirivu oyo alina okukkiriza mu Yesu." Wano tuyigirizibwa nti abantu baweebwa obutuukirivu nga bakkirizza Yesu. Okusingawo, Abaruumi 4:5 kikifuula kitegeerekeke n’okusingawo, "Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye." Wano Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng’ayogerera mu Mutume Pawulo, atugamba nti abo abakkiriza Yesu okukkiriza kwabwe kubalibwa okuba obutuukirivu. Mu bigambo ebirala, okukkiriza kwe kufuula omusaayi ogwayiika, gwe musingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, okuba ogwaffe, era tuweebwa obutuukirivu bwe tukkiriza. Abantu bonna basobola okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okufa kwa Kristo ku musaalaba, naye abakkiriza baweebwa ddala obutuukirivu nga beetwalira omuwendo gw’obutuukirivu oguli mu musaayi gwa Kristo ogwayiika, olw’okumukkiriza obukkiriza. Mu bigambo ebirala, omusaayi gwa Kristo ogwayiika gwe musingi gwokka era ogumala ddala ogw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu: okukkiriza obukkiriza Yesu Kristo eyayiwa omusaayi ogwo, kye kisaanyizo kyokka eky’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Katonda tasaba mwonoonyi kintu kirala kyonna okuggyako okukkiriza Omwana we, Yesu Kristo, era bw’akkiriza bw’atyo aweebwa obutuukirivu. Bwe tukkiriza tuweebwa obutuukirivu, ka tube nga tulina ebikolwa bye tuwaayo oba nedda; oba, nga Pawulo bw’akyogera mu Abaruumi 3:28, "Noolwekyo omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu lwa kukkiriza so si lwa kugoberera mateeka." Oba, nga bwe kyogerwa mu lunyiriri lwe twajuliza edda, Abaruumi 4:5, "Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye." Omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu awatali bikolwa bya mateeka n’akatono, kwe kugamba, aweebwa obutuukirivu ku kisaanyizo eky’okukkiriza Yesu Kristo, ne bw’aba nga talina bikolwa by’awaayo ng’omusingi kw’asinziira okusaba okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Bwe tulekera awo okukolerera okuweebwa obutuukirivu ne "tukkiriza obukkiriza Oyo awa abatatya Katonda obutuukirivu," okukkiriza okwo kutubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu, era bwe tutyo tubalibwa nga batuukirivu. Kale ekibuuzo si kye kino nti, olina ebikolwa by’owaayo? Wabula kiri nti, okkiriza Oyo awa abatatya Katonda obutuukirivu? Ebikolwa tebirina kakwate na kuweebwa butuukirivu, okuggyako okukuziyiza bwe tubyesiga. Omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo gwe gukufuna, okukkiriza Yesu Kristo kwe kukwetwalira. Tuweebwa obutuukirivu si lwa bikolwa byaffe, wabula olw’omulimu gwe. Tuweebwa obutuukirivu ku musingi omwangu era ogumu ogw’omusaayi gwe ogwayiika, ne ku kisaanyizo ekyangu era ekimu eky’okukkiriza kwaffe mu Oyo eyayiwa omusaayi. Amalala g’omutima ogw’obuzaaliranwa ganene nnyo ne kiba kizibu nnyo okunywereza abantu ku njigiriza eno ey’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza kwokka awatali bikolwa bya mateeka. Buli kiseera tuba tunoonya okuyingiza ebikolwa byaffe awantu wonna.

5. Naye tetunnaddamu mu bujjuvu kibuuzo ky’engeri abantu gye baweebwamu obutuukirivu. Waliwo oludda olulala olw’amazima, era bwe tuba ab’okuba n’enjigiriza ey’okuweebwa obutuukirivu enzijuvu era etebuusebuuse, tuteekwa okutunuulira oludda olwo olulala. Ekitundu ky’oludda luno olulala ojja kukisanga mu Abaruumi 10:8, 10, "Bw’oyatula n’akamwa ko nti, Yesu ye Mukama, n’okkiriza n’omutima gwo nga Katonda yamuzuukiza mu bafu, olokoka. Kubanga omuntu akkiriza na mutima gwe n’aweebwa obutuukirivu, era ayatula na kamwa ke n’alokoka." Wano Katonda atugamba nti okukkiriza okwetwalira okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwe kukkiriza okw’omu mutima, kwe kugamba, okukkiriza okutali ndowooza buzzi oba kirowoozo, wabula okukkiriza okuleeta ebikolwa ebituukana n’okukkiriza okwo, era noolwekyo kwe kukkiriza okutuusa ku kwatula mu lwatu n’akamwa nti Yesu ye Mukama waffe. Omuntu bw’aba n’okukkiriza okw’engeri emu, oba ky’ayita okukkiriza, okutamutuusa ku kwatula Kristo mu lwatu, aba n’okukkiriza okutamuweesa butuukirivu; kubanga si kukkiriza kwa mu mutima. Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo yennyini atugamba nti okukkiriza okw’omu mutima kutuusa ku kwatula mu lwatu; kubanga agamba mu Matayo 12:34, "Akamwa koogera ku biba bijjudde mu mutima." Okukkiriza Yesu Kristo mu mutima tekuyinza butatuusa ku kwatula Yesu nga Mukama n’akamwa, era bw’oba toyatula Yesu nga Mukama wo n’akamwa ko, tolina kukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu era toweereddwa butuukirivu.

6. Ekitundu ekirala eky’amazima agakwata ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza, ojja kukisanga mu Yakobo 2:14, 18-24, R. V. "Abooluganda, kibagasa ki okugamba nti mulina okukkiriza kyokka ng’okukkiriza kwammwe temukwoleka mu bikolwa? Mulowooza ng’okukkiriza ng’okwo kugenda kubalokola?" Wano tulaba nti okukkiriza omuntu kw’agamba obugambi nti alina, naye nga tekumutuusa ku bikolwa ebikwatagana n’ebyo by’agamba nti akkiriza, tekuyinza kumuweesa butuukirivu. Naye tweyongereyo, olunyiriri 18-24, "Naye omuntu ayinza okugamba nti, Ggwe olina okukkiriza nange nnina ebikolwa; ndaga okukkiriza kwo okutaliiko bikolwa, nange nkulage ebikolwa byange nga bwe bikakasa okukkiriza kwange. Okukkiriza obukkiriza nti waliwo Katonda omu yekka, kirungi. Naye ne baddayimooni nabo bakkiriza n’okukankana ne bakankana! Musirusiru ggwe! Oliyiga ddi ng’okukkiriza okutaliiko bikolwa tekuliiko kye kugasa? Jjajjaffe Ibulayimu teyaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ekikolwa kye yakola, bwe yawaayo omwana we Isaaka, afiire ku kyoto? Mulaba nga Ibulayimu bwe yalina okukkiriza, era okukkiriza kwe ne kutuukirizibwa olw’ebikolwa bye (kwe kugamba, mu bikolwa okukkiriza kwa Ibulayimu bye kwamutuusaako, okukkiriza mwe kwalabikira mu bujjuvu bwakwo); n’ekyawandiikibwa ne kituukirizibwa ekigamba nti, Ibulayimu yakkiriza Katonda, ne kimubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu, era n’ayitibwa mukwano gwa Katonda. Kaakano mutegedde ng’omuntu asiimibwa Katonda olw’ebyo by’akola, so si lwa kukkiriza kyokka." Abamu balaba mu bigambo bino okukontana wakati w’enjigiriza ya Yakobo n’eya Pawulo, naye tewali kukontana n’akatono. Wabula Yakobo wano atuyigiriza amazima amakulu, gano: okukkiriza omuntu kw’agamba nti alina, naye nga tekweyoleka mu bikolwa ebikwatagana n’okukkiriza kw’ayatula, tekuweesa muntu butuukirivu. Okukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu kwe kukkiriza okwa nnamaddala okututuusa ku bikolwa ebikwatagana n’amazima ge twatula nti tugakkiriza. Kya mazima nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza kwokka awatali bikolwa bya mateeka, naye kulina kuba kukkiriza kwa nnamaddala, bwe kitaba bwe kityo tekuweesa butuukirivu. Ng’omuntu omu bwe yakyogera, "Tuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza awatali bikolwa, naye tetuweebwa butuukirivu olw’okukkiriza okutaliiko bikolwa." Okukkiriza Katonda kw’alaba, era kw’asinziirako okuwa omuntu obutuukirivu, tekulema kuleeta bikolwa abantu bye balaba. Katonda yalaba okukkiriza kwa Ibulayimu mu kaseera kennyini Ibulayimu mwe yakkiririza, nga tannafuna kakisa konna kukola, n’akumubalira okuba obutuukirivu. Naye okukkiriza Katonda kwe yalaba kwali kwa nnamaddala, era kwatuusa Ibulayimu ku bikolwa buli muntu bye yali asobola okulaba, era ebikolwa ebyo ne bikakasa nti okukkiriza kwe kwali kwa nnamaddala. Gye tuli, obukakafu bw’okukkiriza bwe bikolwa, era tumanyi nti oyo atakola talina kukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu.

Ku ludda olumu tetulina kwerabira mazima Pawulo ge yanyweza ng’alwanyisa enjigiriza y’okwesiga amateeka, kwe kugamba nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu ku kakwakkulizo kamu kokka era akangu: okukkiriza Kristo okwa nnamaddala; naye ku ludda olulala tetulina kwerabira mazima Yakobo ge yanyweza ng’alwanyisa abagamba nti amateeka tegakyabakwatako, kwe kugamba nti okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala kwokka, okukakasa obwannamaddala bwakwo mu bikolwa, kwe kuweesa obutuukirivu. Omuntu eyeesiga amateeka, agezaako okukola ekintu asaanire okuweebwa obutuukirivu, tulina okumugamba nti, "Lekera awo okukola, okkirize oyo aweesa abatatya Katonda obutuukirivu" (Abaruumi 4:5). Omuntu agamba nti amateeka tegamukwatako, kwe kugamba, oyo alowooza nti ayinza okubeera mu bulamu obutagondera mateeka, obw’obulagajjavu, obutayawukana na nsi, obw’ekibi, era n’akyaweebwa obutuukirivu, oyo eyeewaana nti alina okukkiriza era nti kwe kumuweesa obutuukirivu, naye nga talaga kukkiriza kwe mu bikolwa bye, tulina okumugamba nti, "Kigasa ki, omuntu bw’agamba nti alina okukkiriza, naye nga talina bikolwa? Okukkiriza okwo kuyinza okumulokola?" (Yakobo 2:14, R. V.) Tuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza kwokka, naye tetuweebwa butuukirivu olw’okukkiriza okuli kwokka, wabula olw’okukkiriza okugenda awamu n’ebikolwa.

III. OBUNENE BW’OKUWEEBWA OBUTUUKIRIVU

Ndowooza tulaze bulungi engeri omuntu gy’aweebwamu obutuukirivu, era kaakano tutuuse ku kibuuzo ekirala, kino: obunene bw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Omuntu akkiriza Mukama Yesu aweebwa obutuukirivu okutuuka wa? Ekibuuzo kino kiddibwamu mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo, ey’ekitalo era ey’ekitiibwa mu Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:38, 39, "Abooluganda, mumpulirize! Mu muntu ono Yesu okusonyiyibwa ebibi mwe kubuuliddwa. Kino nga tekiyinzika mu mateeka ga Musa. Buli amukkiriza n’amwesiga aggyibwako omusango gw’ekibi, n’aweebwa obutuukirivu." Ebigambo bino bitulangirira lwatu nti buli akkiriza Yesu Kristo aweebwa obutuukirivu "mu byonna." Mu bigambo ebirala, ebbanja lyonna ery’edda omukkiriza lye yali avunaanibwa lisangulibwawo. Ne bwe liba ebbi era eriddugavu ennyo lityo, mu kaseera omuntu w’akkiririza Yesu Kristo, ebbanja eryo lisangulibwawo. Katonda talina kantu na kamu k’abalira oyo akkiriza Yesu Kristo. Newakubadde ng’akyali mukkiriza atannatuukirira n’akatono, omuto ennyo era Omukristaayo atannakula, aweereddwa obutuukirivu mu bujjuvu. Nga Pawulo bw’akyogera mu Abaruumi 8:1, "Noolwekyo abo abali mu Kristo Yesu, tebaliiko musango." Oba nga bw’akyogera wansi mu ssuula y’emu, olunyiriri 33, 34, "Ani aliroopa abalonde ba Katonda? Katonda y’awa obutuukirivu. Ani alibasalira omusango? Kristo Yesu yafa, kyokka okusinga byonna yazuukizibwa, era ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, ng’atwegayiririra." Singa omutemu asinga obubi oba omwonoonyi omubi ennyo ow’engeri yonna ku nsi ayingira wano enkya ya leero, era wano kaakano, ng’awulira enjiri y’ekisa kya Katonda, n’akkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo, n’amwesiga nga Omulokozi we, n’amusembeza bw’atyo, ng’amwewaayo era ng’amwatula nga Mukama we, mu kaseera ako kennyini buli kibi kye yali akoze kyandisangulibwawo, era ebimuwandiikiddwako byandibadde byeru mu maaso ga Katonda ng’ebya malayika asinga obutukuvu mu ggulu. Katonda talina kantu na kamu k’abalira akkiriza Yesu Kristo. Naye ekyo si kye kyokka. Pawulo agenda n’ewala okusingawo mu 2 Abakkolinso 5:21, "Kubanga oyo ataamanya kibi, yafuuka ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu." Wano tubuulirwa lwatu nti akkiriza Yesu Kristo afuulibwa obutuukirivu bwa Katonda mu Kristo. Mu Abafiripi 3:9, R. V. tubuulirwa nti omuntu bw’aba mu Kristo aba n’obutuukirivu obutali bubwe, wabula "obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda obwesigamye ku kukkiriza." Mu bigambo ebirala, wabaawo okuwaanyisiganya ebifo okw’enkomeredde wakati wa Kristo n’omukkiriza aweereddwa obutuukirivu. Kristo yatwala ekifo kyaffe, ekifo ky’ekikolimo ku musaalaba (Abaggalatiya 3:13). "Yafuuka ekibi ku lwaffe" (2 Abakkolinso 5:21). Katonda yamubala ng’omwonoonyi era n’amukolako ng’omwonoonyi, ne kiba nti mu kifo ky’omwonoonyi, bwe yali afa, yakaaba nti, "Katonda wange, Katonda wange, lwaki onjabulidde?" Era bwe tuweebwa obutuukirivu tuyingira mu kifo kye, ekifo eky’okukkirizibwa okutuukiridde mu maaso ga Katonda, oba okukozesa ebigambo by’Ekyawandiikibwa byennyini, "Tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu." Okuweebwa obutuukirivu kusinga okusonyiyibwa! Okusonyiyibwa kwa ludda lwa kuggyawo, kwe kuggyibwako ekibi; Okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwa ludda lwa kugattako, kwe kubalirwa obutuukirivu obutuukiridde ddala oyo aweereddwa obutuukirivu. Yesu Kristo yeegatta n’omukkiriza mu ye ne kiba nti Katonda amubalira ebibi byaffe. Ate omukkiriza yeegatta ne Kristo ne kiba nti Katonda atubalira obutuukirivu bwe. Katonda tatulaba nga bwe tuli ffekka, wabula nga bwe tuli mu ye, n’atubala nga batuukirivu nga ye bw’ali. Omulimu gwa Kristo munda mu ffe bwe gulimala okutuukirizibwa, tuliba ddala kye tuli dda mu kubala kwa Katonda, naye mu kaseera omuntu w’akkiririza, ku bikwata ku kubala kwa Katonda, aba atuukiridde ddala nga bw’aliba emirembe gyonna. Embeera yaffe mu maaso ga Katonda kaakano etuukiridde ddala, wadde ng’obulamu bwaffe obw’omunda kaakano buyinza okuba nga tebunnatuukirira n’akatono. Okukozesa nate oluyimba olumanyiddwa:

"Kumpi, kumpi nnyo ne Katonda,
Sisobola kusingawo;
Kubanga mu Mwana we,
Ndi kumpi nga ye bw’ali.

Omwagalwa, omwagalwa nnyo wa Katonda,
Sisobola kusingawo;
Kubanga mu Mwana we,
Njagalibwa nga ye bw’ali."

IV. EKISEERA EKY’OKUWEEBWA OBUTUUKIRIVU

Wasigaddeyo ekibuuzo kimu eky’okulowoozaako, wadde nga mu butuufu tukiddiddemu mu bye tumaze okwogera, kino: ekiseera eky’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, oba omukkiriza ddi lw’aweebwa obutuukirivu. Omukkiriza aweebwa ddi obutuukirivu? Ekibuuzo kino kiddibwamu lwatu mu kimu ku byawandiikibwa byaffe, Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:39, "Buli amukkiriza n’amwesiga aggyibwako omusango gw’ekibi, n’aweebwa obutuukirivu." Kye njagala mwetegereze ennyo kaakano mu lunyiriri luno kye kigambo Aweebwa, "Buli akkiriza aweebwa obutuukirivu mu byonna." Kino kiddamu lwatu ekibuuzo ky’ekiseera omukkiriza w’aweerwa obutuukirivu. Mu Kristo Yesu buli amukkiriza aweebwa obutuukirivu mu byonna mu kaseera ke yakkiririzaamu. Mu kaseera omuntu w’akkiririza Yesu Kristo, mu kaseera ako yeegatta ne Kristo, era mu kaseera ako Katonda amubalira obutuukirivu bwa Katonda. Nziramu nate, singa omutemu asinga obubi oba omwonoonyi omubi ennyo ow’engeri yonna mu nsi ayingira mu kisenge kino enkya ya leero nga mbuulira, n’akkiriza wano kaakano Mukama Yesu Kristo, mu kaseera ako kennyini, si nti buli kibi kye yali akoze kyandisangulibwawo kyokka, naye n’obutuukirivu bwonna obutuukiridde obwa Katonda mu Kristo bwandiwandiikiddwa ku linnya lye, era embeera ye mu maaso ga Katonda yandibadde etuukiridde nga bw’eriba ng’amaze mu ggulu emyaka obukadde kakumi. Ka mbaddiremu nate ekyaliwo kye nnabanyumiza ku Ssande emu ekiro wiiki ntono eziyise. Nnali mbuulira ku Ssande emu ku makya mu kkanisa ya Moody e Chicago ku Abaruumi 8:1, "Noolwekyo abo abali mu Kristo Yesu, tebaliiko musango," era bwe nnali mbuulira ne njogera nti, "Singa omukazi asinga obubi mu Chicago ayingira mu kkanisa ya Chicago Avenue enkya ya leero, n’asembeza wano kaakano Yesu Kristo nga Omulokozi we, mu kaseera ako kennyini buli kibi kye yali akoze kyandisangulibwawo era ebimuwandiikiddwako byandibadde byeru mu maaso ga Katonda ng’eby’omukazi asinga obutukuvu mu kisenge muno." Nze nga simanyi, omu ku bammemba b’ekibiina kyange ku makya ago gennyini yali aserengese mu kifo ekibi eky’obwonoonyi okumpi n’omugga, n’ayita omukazi eyali yeesuuliddwa abantu ajje ampulire nga mbuulira. Omukazi oyo n’addamu nti, "Sigenda mu kkanisa n’akatono. Ekkanisa si ya bantu nga nze. Sandyanirizibwa mu kkanisa singa ŋŋenda." Omukazi omutukuvu n’addamu nti, "Wandyanirizibwa mu kkanisa yaffe," era ekyo, Katonda yeebazibwe, kyali kituufu. Naye, "Nedda," omukazi n’akalambira, "tekiŋŋanye kugenda mu kkanisa, ekkanisa si ya bantu nga nze." Naye omukazi omutukuvu n’akubiriza omukazi omwonoonyi okugenda. Ne yeewaayo okumuwerekera okutuuka ku kkanisa, naye omulala n’agamba nti, "Nedda, ekyo tekiyinzika. Abapoliisi bammanyi n’abalenzi ab’oku kkubo bammanyi era oluusi bankasuukirira amayinja, era singa bakulaba ng’oyambuka ekkubo nange, bandikulowoozezza okuba ow’engeri yange." Naye omukazi omutukuvu yalina Omwoyo gwa Mukama we, n’agamba nti, "Sifaayo kye banandowoozaako. Bw’onokkiriza okujja okuwulira Omwami Torrey ng’abuulira, nja kutambula naawe." Omukazi omulala n’agaana. Naye omukazi eyali alokose n’akalambira nnyo ne kiba nti omukazi eyali yeesuuliddwa ku nkomerero n’agamba nti, "Bw’onotambula mu maaso gange amabanga matono, nja kukugoberera mu kkubo." Bwe batyo ne bayambuka La Salle Avenue, omukazi omutukuvu ng’akulembedde amabanga matono, n’omukazi omwonoonyi ng’agoberera amabanga matono emabega. Ne batambula ebibangirizi ku bibangirizi okutuusa lwe baatuuka ku nsonda ya La Salle ne Chicago Avenues. Omukazi omutukuvu n’ayingira mu luggi lw’omunaala ku nsonda, n’alinnya amadaala, n’ayingira mu kkanisa, n’omukazi omwonoonyi n’amugoberera. Bwe yatuuka ku luggi, omukazi omwonoonyi n’alingiza munda, n’alaba entebe etaliiko muntu wansi wa gale mu lunyiriri olusembayo ddala emabega, n’agyesogga, era yali yaakatuula ne njogera ebigambo bye mmaze okujuliza, "Singa omukazi asinga obubi mu Chicago ayingira mu kkanisa ya Chicago Avenue enkya ya leero n’asembeza wano kaakano Yesu Kristo nga Omulokozi we ku bubwe, mu kaseera ako kennyini buli kibi kye yali akoze kyandisangulibwawo era ebimuwandiikiddwako byandibadde byeru mu maaso ga Katonda ng’eby’omukazi asinga obutukuvu mu kisenge muno." Ebigambo byange ne bibuuka okuyita mu bawuliriza ne bigwa mu mutima gw’omukazi omwonoonyi. N’akikkiriza, n’akkiriza nti Yesu yamufiirira, n’akkiriza nti olw’okuyiwa omusaayi gwe ayinza okulokolebwa, n’akkiriza, n’afuna okusonyiyibwa n’emirembe n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu mu kaseera ako wennyini. Olukuŋŋaana bwe lwaggwa n’ajja mu kkubo wakati okutuuka mu maaso nga nkka okuva ku kituuti, amaziga nga gamukulukuta ku matama, n’anneebaza olw’omukisa gwe yali afunye. Era nkiddamu wano enkya ya leero, nga simanyi ani ayinza okuba wano, nga simanyi bulamu bwa kyama bwa muntu yenna ku mmwe ali wano, nga simanyi bibi ki ebiyinza okuba nga bikwekeddwa mu mutima gwo, singa omusajja oba omukazi asinga obubi ku nsi ayingira mu Church of the Open Door enkya ya leero n’ateeka wano kaakano obwesige bwe mu Yesu Kristo, mu kaseera ako kennyini buli kibi kye wali okoze kyandisangulibwawo, era mu kaseera katono ebikuwandiikiddwako byandibadde byeru mu maaso ga Katonda, si ng’eby’omukazi asinga obutukuvu mu kisenge muno kyokka, naye ng’ebya malayika asinga obutukuvu mu ggulu, era si ekyo kyokka, naye obutuukirivu bwonna obutuukiridde obwa Katonda obwambaza Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo bwandiwandiikiddwa ku linnya lyo, era wandibadde kumpi ne Katonda era omwagalwa we nga Mukama Yesu Kristo yennyini bw’ali. Eyo y’enjigiriza y’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza. Enjigiriza ey’ekitalo! Enjigiriza ey’ekitiibwa!
fields.body_text: "Abooluganda, mumpulirize! Mu muntu ono Yesu okusonyiyibwa ebibi mwe kubuuliddwa. Kino nga tekiyinzika mu mateeka ga Musa. Buli amukkiriza n’amwesiga aggyibwako omusango gw’ekibi, n’aweebwa obutuukirivu."—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:38, 39. "Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye."—Abaruumi 4:5. Bino bitundu bibiri ebyewuunyisa, era essuula eno ejja kwemalira ku kubinnyonnyola. Omulamwa gwaffe enkya ya leero gwe guno: Enjigiriza Eyawula Abaprotestanti: Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza. Enjigiriza y’Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza ye yazaala Enkyukakyuka (Reformation). Ne leero y’emu ku njigiriza enkulu ez’Okukkiriza kw’Enjiri. Enjigiriza eno, wadde Pawulo ye yasooka okuginnyonnyola mu bujjuvu n’agiggumiza buli kiseera, eyita mu Bayibuli yonna okuva mu Olubereberye okutuuka mu Okubikkulirwa. Mu kitabo kya Bayibuli ekisooka, ekitabo ky’Olubereberye, mwe tusoma nti, "Ibulaamu n’akkiriza Mukama, n’akimubalira okuba obutuukirivu." (Olubereberye 15:6.) Mu bigambo bino, mu kitabo kya Bayibuli ekisookera ddala, mwe tusanga ensigo y’enjigiriza yonna ey’ekisa era ey’omuwendo ey’Okuweebwa Obutuukirivu olw’Okukkiriza. I. OKUWEEBWA OBUTUUKIRIVU KYE KI? Ekintu ekisooka kye tulina okutegeera obulungi kwe kumanya okuweebwa obutuukirivu kye kiri ddala. Wano bangi we bawabira nga basoma amazima gano amakulu. Waliwo amakulu abiri agawukana ddala ag’ebigambo "okuwa obutuukirivu" n’"okuweebwa obutuukirivu." Amakulu amu agagamba nti okuwa obutuukirivu kwe kufuula omuntu omutuukirivu, n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwe kufuulibwa omutuukirivu. Amakulu amalala agagamba nti "okuwa obutuukirivu" kwe kubala, kulangirira oba kulaga nti omuntu mutuukirivu, n’"okuweebwa obutuukirivu" kwe kulangirirwa oba kubalibwa nga mutuukirivu. Ku makulu gano abiri agawukana, amasomero abiri ag’endowooza we gaawukanira. Makulu ki amatuufu? Engeri y’okumanya amakulu g’ekigambo kyonna mu Bayibuli kwe kwekenneenya ebitundu byonna ekigambo ekyo n’ebiva mu kyo mwe bisangibwa. Omuntu yenna bw’anaayita mu Bayibuli, Endagaano Enkadde n’Empya, n’asoma n’obwegendereza ebitundu byonna ekigambo "okuwa obutuukirivu" n’ebiva mu kyo mwe bisangibwa, ajja kukizuula nti awatali kubuusabuusa, mu ngeri Bayibuli gy’ekozesaamu ekigambo, "okuwa obutuukirivu" tekitegeeza kufuula muntu mutuukirivu, wabula kumubala nga mutuukirivu, kumulangirira nga mutuukirivu, oba kulaga nti mutuukirivu. Omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda Katonda bw’amubala nga mutuukirivu. Kino kirabikira, okugeza, mu ssuula ey’okuna ey’Abaruumi, olunyiriri olwa 2 okutuuka ku lwa 8, R. V. "Singa Ibulayimu yaweebwa obutuukirivu lwa bikolwa, yandyenyumirizza, naye si eri Katonda. Ebyawandiikibwa bitugamba bitya? Ibulayimu yakkiriza Katonda ne kimubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu. Omuntu bw’akola omulimu, asasulwa empeera ye. Empeera gy’aweebwa, teba kirabo. Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye. Kabaka Dawudi naye yayogera kye kimu ku muntu ono Katonda gw’awa obutuukirivu obutavudde mu bikolwa bye ng’agamba nti: Baweereddwa omukisa, abasonyiyiddwa ebyonoono byabwe, ne baggyibwako ebibi byabwe. Aweereddwa omukisa omuntu, Mukama gw’atalibalira kibi." Kyeyoleka bulungi okuva mu kitundu kino, era ne mu bitundu ebirala bingi, nti omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu Katonda bw’amubala nga mutuukirivu, ka kibe nti empisa ze n’enneeyisa ye byali bitya. Oluvannyuma tujja kulaba nti okuweebwa obutuukirivu kusinga okusonyiyibwa obusonyiyibwa. II. ABANTU BAWEEBWA BATYA OBUTUUKIRIVU? Kaakano tutuuse ku kibuuzo eky’okubiri, era ekikulu ennyo okusinga byonna: Abantu baweebwa batya obutuukirivu? Okutwalira awamu waliwo endowooza bbiri ezikontana ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu: emu egamba nti abantu baweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa byabwe bo, kwe kugamba, olw’ekintu kye bakola bo bennyini. Endowooza eno eyinza okwogerwa mu ngeri nnyingi. Ebikolwa ebirungi abantu bye boogerako ng’omusingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu bayinza okuba empisa zaabwe ennungi, oba okukuuma kwabwe Etteeka Erya Zaabu, oba ekintu ekiringa ekyo. Oba biyinza okuba ebikolwa by’eddiini, gamba ng’okwebonereza olw’ebibi, okwogera essaala, okwegatta ku kkanisa, okugenda mu kkanisa, okubatizibwa, oba okulya ku Ky’Ekiro kya Mukama, oba okutuukiriza emirimu emirala egy’eddiini. Naye bino byonna bikomekkereza kye kimu: kintu ffe kye tukola ffe bennyini ekireeta okuweebwa obutuukirivu; ebikolwa byaffe ffe, ebikolwa bye tukola, bye bitwalibwa ng’omusingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Endowooza endala ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu egamba nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu, si lwa bikolwa byaffe mu ngeri yonna, wabula olw’omulimu gw’omulala gwokka, kwe kugamba, olw’okufa kwa Yesu Kristo okw’okutangirira ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo; nti ebikolwa byaffe tebirina kakwate na kuweebwa butuukirivu bwaffe, wabula tuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’omulimu gwa Kristo ogw’okutangirira gwe yamaliriza era ogujjuvu, olw’okufa kwe ku Musaalaba ku lwaffe; era nti kye tulina okukola ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu bwaffe kwe kukwetwalira obwetwalizi nga twesiga bwesizi Oyo eyakola okutangirira. Ndowooza ki entuufu? Tujja kugenda butereevu mu Bayibuli okufuna eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo kino ekikulu ennyo. 1. Ekitundu ekisooka eky’okuddamu tujja kukisanga mu Abaruumi 3:20, "Kubanga tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka. Mu mateeka mwe tutegeerera ddala ekibi." Wano kyogerwa bulungi nnyo nti tetuweebwa butuukirivu lwa kukuuma mateeka ga Katonda, ka gabe amateeka ga Musa oba amateeka amalala gonna, era nti amateeka gaaweebwa, si kutuleetera kuweebwa butuukirivu, wabula okutumanyisa ekibi, kwe kugamba, okututuusa ku kutegeera nti twetaaga okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ekisa. Kyogerwa bulungi wano nti tewali muntu aweebwa butuukirivu lwa bikolwa bya mateeka. Amazima ago gamu amakulu gasangibwa mu Abaggalatiya 2:16: "Kyokka tukimanyi bulungi nti omuntu taweebwa butuukirivu lwa kugondera mateeka, wabula abufuna lwa kukkiriza Yesu Kristo, era naffe kyetwava tukkiriza Yesu Kristo tulyoke tuweebwe obutuukirivu olw’okumukkiriza so si lwa kugondera mateeka. Kubanga tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa eby’amateeka." Okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa byaffe byonna tekisoboka. Tekisoboka kubanga okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka, oba olw’ekintu kyonna kye tusobola okukola, tuteekwa okukuuma amateeka ga Katonda mu bujjuvu. Amateeka gasaba obuwulize obutuukiridde ng’omusingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Gagamba nti, "Buli ataagobererenga byonna ebiwandiikiddwa mu kitabo ky’amateeka, akolimiddwa." (Abaggalatiya 3:10.). Naye tewali n’omu ku ffe yakuuma amateeka ga Katonda mu bujjuvu, era mu kaseera ke tumenya etteeka lya Katonda mu kantu konna, okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa kufuuka ekitasoboka ddala. Kale ku bikwata ku mateeka ga Katonda, buli omu ku ffe ali "wansi w’ekikolimo," era bwe tuba ab’okuweebwa obutuukirivu n’akatono, tuteekwa okunoonya ekkubo eddala ery’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, so si kukuuma mateeka ga Katonda. Katonda teyawa muntu mateeka ng’asuubira oba ng’ayagala agakuume aweebwe obutuukirivu olw’ekyo. Yabawa amateeka okubaleetera okumanya nti boonoonyi, okuziba emimwa gy’abantu, n’okubatuusa eri Kristo. Oba, nga Pawulo bw’akyogera mu Abaruumi 3:19, 20, "Tumanyi nga buli kyawandiikibwa mu mateeka, kyawandiikibwa ku lw’abo abafugibwa amateeka. Amateeka malambulukufu ku nsonga ezo, omuntu yenna aleme okwekwasa ensonga yonna, ate era ne Katonda okwongera okulaga ng’ensi yonna bwe yasobya. Kubanga tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka. Mu mateeka mwe tutegeerera ddala ekibi." Wadde ebigambo bino ebya Katonda bitegeerekeka bulungi bwe bityo, eky’ewuunyisa kiri nti leero waliwo bangi ababuulira amateeka ng’ekkubo ery’obulokozi. Naye bwe babuulira bwe batyo baba babuulira ekkubo ery’obulokozi eddala, eritali eryo eryateekebwawo mu kigambo kya Katonda yennyini. 2. Ekitundu eky’okubiri eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo ky’engeri gye tuweebwamu obutuukirivu tukisanga mu Abaruumi 3:24. "Kyokka twaweebwa obutuukirivu bwa buwa olw’ekisa kye ekiri mu kununulibwa okuli mu Yesu Kristo;" Ekigambo ekyavvuunulwa "bwa buwa" mu kitundu kino kitegeeza ng’ekirabo eky’obwereere, era olunyiriri lutugamba nti abantu baweebwa obutuukirivu ng’ekirabo eky’obwereere olw’ekisa kya Katonda (kwe kugamba, okusiima kwa Katonda kwe tutasaanira) okuyita mu (kwe kugamba, nga kusinziira ku) kununulibwa okuli mu Kristo Yesu. Mu bigambo ebirala, okuweebwa obutuukirivu tekusinziira ku kusaanira kwonna okuli mu ffe, tekusinziira ku kintu kyonna kye twakola; tetuweebwa butuukirivu lwa bikolwa byaffe wadde olw’empisa zaffe. Okuweebwa obutuukirivu kirabo kya bwereere Katonda ky’awa awatali kusasulwa n’akatono. Omukutu ekirabo kino eky’obwereere mwe kiyita kwe kununulibwa okuli mu Kristo Yesu. Oluvannyuma tujja kulaba nti kino kitegeeza olw’omuwendo Kristo gwe yasasula okutununula, kwe kugamba, okuyiwa omusaayi gwe ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo. 3. Kino kitutuusa ku kitundu eky’okusatu eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo, abantu baweebwa batya obutuukirivu. Ekitundu kino eky’okusatu eky’okuddamu tukisanga mu Abaruumi 5:9, "Kale obanga twaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’omusaayi gwe, alitulokola okuva mu busungu bwa Katonda." Wano tugambibwa mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu, oba tubalibwa nga batuukirivu "olw’," oba okusinga mu bigambo ebyo ddala, "mu," musaayi gwa Kristo, kwe kugamba, olw’okufa kwa Kristo okw’omutango. Ffenna twali wansi w’ekikolimo ky’amateeka ga Katonda agaamenyebwa, kubanga ffenna twali tugamenye, naye bwe yafa mu kifo kyaffe ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo, Mukama waffe Yesu "Kristo yatununula okuva mu kikolimo ky’amateeka, bwe yafuuka ekikolimo ku lwaffe, kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti, Akolimiddwa buli awanikiddwa ku muti." (Abaggalatiya 3:13.) Oba, nga Peetero bw’akyogera mu 1 Peetero 2:24, "Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe." Oba nga Pawulo bw’akyogera nate mu 2 Abakkolinso 5:21, "Kubanga oyo ataamanya kibi, (Katonda) yamufuula ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu." Tujja kufuna omukisa okuddamu okwogera ku kitundu kino oluvannyuma. Kye njagala mukirabe kyokka mu kiseera kino kiri nti tubalibwa nga batuukirivu olw’okuba Yesu Kristo yayimirira mu kifo kyaffe, olw’okutwala ekifo kye twali tusaanidde; ku musaalaba. Omusingi gumu gwokka ogw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu gwe musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo ogwayiika. Kya lwatu nti enjigiriza eno ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kwa Christian Science, era ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kw’ebingi ebiyitibwa New Theology, era ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kwa New Thought ne Theosophy, era ya njawulo ddala ku kuyigiriza kwa Unitarian, naye kwe kuyigiriza kw’Ekigambo kya Katonda. Okuyigiriza kuno kwe kumu tukusanga nga kwogerwa bulungi nnabbi Isaaya emyaka lusanvu nga Mukama waffe tannazaalibwa, mu Isaaya 53:6, w’agamba nti, "Ffenna twawaba ng’endiga; buli omu ku ffe n’akwata ekkubo lye; Mukama n’ateeka (mu bigambo ebyo ddala, n’akikubya) ku ye (kwe kugamba, ku Mukama Yesu) obutali butuukirivu bwaffe ffenna." Kino kinywereze bulungi mu birowoozo byo, nti omusingi gwokka, naye ogumala ddala, abantu kwe basinziira okuweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda gwe musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo ogwayiika, Yesu Kristo gwe yawaayo ng’okutangirira olw’ebibi byaffe era Katonda Kitaffe gwe yakkiriza ng’okutangirira okumala ddala. 4. Ekitundu eky’okuna eky’okuddamu mu kibuuzo, abantu baweebwa batya obutuukirivu, tukisanga mu Abaruumi 3:26, "Kino kyali kulaga, nkyogera, obutuukirivu (kwe kugamba, obwa Katonda) bwe mu kiseera kino: alyoke (kwe kugamba, Katonda) abeere omutuukirivu ye yennyini, era oyo awa obutuukirivu oyo alina okukkiriza mu Yesu." Wano tuyigirizibwa nti abantu baweebwa obutuukirivu nga bakkirizza Yesu. Okusingawo, Abaruumi 4:5 kikifuula kitegeerekeke n’okusingawo, "Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye." Wano Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng’ayogerera mu Mutume Pawulo, atugamba nti abo abakkiriza Yesu okukkiriza kwabwe kubalibwa okuba obutuukirivu. Mu bigambo ebirala, okukkiriza kwe kufuula omusaayi ogwayiika, gwe musingi gw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, okuba ogwaffe, era tuweebwa obutuukirivu bwe tukkiriza. Abantu bonna basobola okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okufa kwa Kristo ku musaalaba, naye abakkiriza baweebwa ddala obutuukirivu nga beetwalira omuwendo gw’obutuukirivu oguli mu musaayi gwa Kristo ogwayiika, olw’okumukkiriza obukkiriza. Mu bigambo ebirala, omusaayi gwa Kristo ogwayiika gwe musingi gwokka era ogumala ddala ogw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu: okukkiriza obukkiriza Yesu Kristo eyayiwa omusaayi ogwo, kye kisaanyizo kyokka eky’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Katonda tasaba mwonoonyi kintu kirala kyonna okuggyako okukkiriza Omwana we, Yesu Kristo, era bw’akkiriza bw’atyo aweebwa obutuukirivu. Bwe tukkiriza tuweebwa obutuukirivu, ka tube nga tulina ebikolwa bye tuwaayo oba nedda; oba, nga Pawulo bw’akyogera mu Abaruumi 3:28, "Noolwekyo omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu lwa kukkiriza so si lwa kugoberera mateeka." Oba, nga bwe kyogerwa mu lunyiriri lwe twajuliza edda, Abaruumi 4:5, "Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye." Omuntu aweebwa obutuukirivu awatali bikolwa bya mateeka n’akatono, kwe kugamba, aweebwa obutuukirivu ku kisaanyizo eky’okukkiriza Yesu Kristo, ne bw’aba nga talina bikolwa by’awaayo ng’omusingi kw’asinziira okusaba okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Bwe tulekera awo okukolerera okuweebwa obutuukirivu ne "tukkiriza obukkiriza Oyo awa abatatya Katonda obutuukirivu," okukkiriza okwo kutubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu, era bwe tutyo tubalibwa nga batuukirivu. Kale ekibuuzo si kye kino nti, olina ebikolwa by’owaayo? Wabula kiri nti, okkiriza Oyo awa abatatya Katonda obutuukirivu? Ebikolwa tebirina kakwate na kuweebwa butuukirivu, okuggyako okukuziyiza bwe tubyesiga. Omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo gwe gukufuna, okukkiriza Yesu Kristo kwe kukwetwalira. Tuweebwa obutuukirivu si lwa bikolwa byaffe, wabula olw’omulimu gwe. Tuweebwa obutuukirivu ku musingi omwangu era ogumu ogw’omusaayi gwe ogwayiika, ne ku kisaanyizo ekyangu era ekimu eky’okukkiriza kwaffe mu Oyo eyayiwa omusaayi. Amalala g’omutima ogw’obuzaaliranwa ganene nnyo ne kiba kizibu nnyo okunywereza abantu ku njigiriza eno ey’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza kwokka awatali bikolwa bya mateeka. Buli kiseera tuba tunoonya okuyingiza ebikolwa byaffe awantu wonna. 5. Naye tetunnaddamu mu bujjuvu kibuuzo ky’engeri abantu gye baweebwamu obutuukirivu. Waliwo oludda olulala olw’amazima, era bwe tuba ab’okuba n’enjigiriza ey’okuweebwa obutuukirivu enzijuvu era etebuusebuuse, tuteekwa okutunuulira oludda olwo olulala. Ekitundu ky’oludda luno olulala ojja kukisanga mu Abaruumi 10:8, 10, "Bw’oyatula n’akamwa ko nti, Yesu ye Mukama, n’okkiriza n’omutima gwo nga Katonda yamuzuukiza mu bafu, olokoka. Kubanga omuntu akkiriza na mutima gwe n’aweebwa obutuukirivu, era ayatula na kamwa ke n’alokoka." Wano Katonda atugamba nti okukkiriza okwetwalira okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwe kukkiriza okw’omu mutima, kwe kugamba, okukkiriza okutali ndowooza buzzi oba kirowoozo, wabula okukkiriza okuleeta ebikolwa ebituukana n’okukkiriza okwo, era noolwekyo kwe kukkiriza okutuusa ku kwatula mu lwatu n’akamwa nti Yesu ye Mukama waffe. Omuntu bw’aba n’okukkiriza okw’engeri emu, oba ky’ayita okukkiriza, okutamutuusa ku kwatula Kristo mu lwatu, aba n’okukkiriza okutamuweesa butuukirivu; kubanga si kukkiriza kwa mu mutima. Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo yennyini atugamba nti okukkiriza okw’omu mutima kutuusa ku kwatula mu lwatu; kubanga agamba mu Matayo 12:34, "Akamwa koogera ku biba bijjudde mu mutima." Okukkiriza Yesu Kristo mu mutima tekuyinza butatuusa ku kwatula Yesu nga Mukama n’akamwa, era bw’oba toyatula Yesu nga Mukama wo n’akamwa ko, tolina kukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu era toweereddwa butuukirivu. 6. Ekitundu ekirala eky’amazima agakwata ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza, ojja kukisanga mu Yakobo 2:14, 18-24, R. V. "Abooluganda, kibagasa ki okugamba nti mulina okukkiriza kyokka ng’okukkiriza kwammwe temukwoleka mu bikolwa? Mulowooza ng’okukkiriza ng’okwo kugenda kubalokola?" Wano tulaba nti okukkiriza omuntu kw’agamba obugambi nti alina, naye nga tekumutuusa ku bikolwa ebikwatagana n’ebyo by’agamba nti akkiriza, tekuyinza kumuweesa butuukirivu. Naye tweyongereyo, olunyiriri 18-24, "Naye omuntu ayinza okugamba nti, Ggwe olina okukkiriza nange nnina ebikolwa; ndaga okukkiriza kwo okutaliiko bikolwa, nange nkulage ebikolwa byange nga bwe bikakasa okukkiriza kwange. Okukkiriza obukkiriza nti waliwo Katonda omu yekka, kirungi. Naye ne baddayimooni nabo bakkiriza n’okukankana ne bakankana! Musirusiru ggwe! Oliyiga ddi ng’okukkiriza okutaliiko bikolwa tekuliiko kye kugasa? Jjajjaffe Ibulayimu teyaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ekikolwa kye yakola, bwe yawaayo omwana we Isaaka, afiire ku kyoto? Mulaba nga Ibulayimu bwe yalina okukkiriza, era okukkiriza kwe ne kutuukirizibwa olw’ebikolwa bye (kwe kugamba, mu bikolwa okukkiriza kwa Ibulayimu bye kwamutuusaako, okukkiriza mwe kwalabikira mu bujjuvu bwakwo); n’ekyawandiikibwa ne kituukirizibwa ekigamba nti, Ibulayimu yakkiriza Katonda, ne kimubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu, era n’ayitibwa mukwano gwa Katonda. Kaakano mutegedde ng’omuntu asiimibwa Katonda olw’ebyo by’akola, so si lwa kukkiriza kyokka." Abamu balaba mu bigambo bino okukontana wakati w’enjigiriza ya Yakobo n’eya Pawulo, naye tewali kukontana n’akatono. Wabula Yakobo wano atuyigiriza amazima amakulu, gano: okukkiriza omuntu kw’agamba nti alina, naye nga tekweyoleka mu bikolwa ebikwatagana n’okukkiriza kw’ayatula, tekuweesa muntu butuukirivu. Okukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu kwe kukkiriza okwa nnamaddala okututuusa ku bikolwa ebikwatagana n’amazima ge twatula nti tugakkiriza. Kya mazima nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza kwokka awatali bikolwa bya mateeka, naye kulina kuba kukkiriza kwa nnamaddala, bwe kitaba bwe kityo tekuweesa butuukirivu. Ng’omuntu omu bwe yakyogera, "Tuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza awatali bikolwa, naye tetuweebwa butuukirivu olw’okukkiriza okutaliiko bikolwa." Okukkiriza Katonda kw’alaba, era kw’asinziirako okuwa omuntu obutuukirivu, tekulema kuleeta bikolwa abantu bye balaba. Katonda yalaba okukkiriza kwa Ibulayimu mu kaseera kennyini Ibulayimu mwe yakkiririza, nga tannafuna kakisa konna kukola, n’akumubalira okuba obutuukirivu. Naye okukkiriza Katonda kwe yalaba kwali kwa nnamaddala, era kwatuusa Ibulayimu ku bikolwa buli muntu bye yali asobola okulaba, era ebikolwa ebyo ne bikakasa nti okukkiriza kwe kwali kwa nnamaddala. Gye tuli, obukakafu bw’okukkiriza bwe bikolwa, era tumanyi nti oyo atakola talina kukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu. Ku ludda olumu tetulina kwerabira mazima Pawulo ge yanyweza ng’alwanyisa enjigiriza y’okwesiga amateeka, kwe kugamba nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu ku kakwakkulizo kamu kokka era akangu: okukkiriza Kristo okwa nnamaddala; naye ku ludda olulala tetulina kwerabira mazima Yakobo ge yanyweza ng’alwanyisa abagamba nti amateeka tegakyabakwatako, kwe kugamba nti okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala kwokka, okukakasa obwannamaddala bwakwo mu bikolwa, kwe kuweesa obutuukirivu. Omuntu eyeesiga amateeka, agezaako okukola ekintu asaanire okuweebwa obutuukirivu, tulina okumugamba nti, "Lekera awo okukola, okkirize oyo aweesa abatatya Katonda obutuukirivu" (Abaruumi 4:5). Omuntu agamba nti amateeka tegamukwatako, kwe kugamba, oyo alowooza nti ayinza okubeera mu bulamu obutagondera mateeka, obw’obulagajjavu, obutayawukana na nsi, obw’ekibi, era n’akyaweebwa obutuukirivu, oyo eyeewaana nti alina okukkiriza era nti kwe kumuweesa obutuukirivu, naye nga talaga kukkiriza kwe mu bikolwa bye, tulina okumugamba nti, "Kigasa ki, omuntu bw’agamba nti alina okukkiriza, naye nga talina bikolwa? Okukkiriza okwo kuyinza okumulokola?" (Yakobo 2:14, R. V.)
